description:

About the Role

Marketing Done Right (MDR) is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency looking for a skilled and motivated PPC Strategist to join our remote Philippines-based team. This is a full ownership role — you will be the primary client partner and account lead responsible for the strategy, execution, and continuous optimization of PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads.

You will work closely with SEO, development, and design teams to ensure that strategies are carried through effectively from planning to delivery. We are looking for an A-player who is seeking a stable, long-term career — not just a freelance gig.

- Conduct client discovery calls, perform in-depth keyword research, and develop budget forecasts

- Build and manage full PPC campaigns (STAGs), including ad copy, assets, and comprehensive pre/post-launch quality assurance

- Execute bid strategy tuning, search term mining, and strategic budget reallocation

- Set up and maintain tracking using CallRail, Google Tag Manager (GTM), and GA4 to ensure accurate, data-driven decision-making

- Lead recurring client check-in calls and produce weekly and monthly performance dashboards

- Coordinate cross-functionally with SEO, design, and development teams to align campaign strategy with overall client goals



Requirements

- Expert-level proficiency in Google Ads — Search, YouTube, Performance Max (PMax), and Display campaigns

- Solid technical knowledge of Google Tag Manager (tags and triggers), GA4, and CallRail

- Strong data analysis skills using Google Sheets and/or Excel — including VLOOKUPs and pivot tables

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for client-facing updates and internal team collaboration

- Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable working in a high-trust remote environment

- Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously is a plus

- Competitive Salary: $1,500 USD/month

- 100% Remote Work: Work from home full-time

title: Customer Service Representative with Property Management Experience
description:
*KINDLY READ THE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY BEFORE YOU APPLY.



EJF Real Estate is a well-established, Property Management company based in the District of Columbia. We are looking for Customer Service Representatives who are responsible, organized, detail oriented, and reliable to join our fun/hard working team. You must have excellent communication skills.



Job purpose:

Serve as the primary point of contact for EJF’s residents, owners, tenants, vendors, and any callers seeking assistance, addressing their questions, and resolving issues.



Roles and Responsibilities:

- First responder on the phone system.

- Answer phone calls and address callers' questions, investigate and resolve their issues, and document calls with clear, complete, and legible notes.

- Log calls in the system, create and update tickets as needed, and follow up with callers when necessary.

- First call resolution (billing inquiries, tenant ledgers, owner statement, and general questions).

- Create tickets for concerns/issues that cannot be resolved during the first call resolution.

- Assign unresolved cases to the appropriate party.

- Management of inbox and sorting mail received.

- Intake of concession requests, research reasons for request, draft concession addendum, submit internal request.

- Process pet requests and addendums.

- Pull utility bills and send them for processing.

- Update HOA fees in Appfolio when receiving notification from the condominium.

- Handle online reviews (troubleshoot, investigation, draft response, if issues have been resolved, ask reviewer to remove the review)

- Communicate effectively with team members and other departments, actively participate in departmental meetings, and request online reviews from callers.

- Meet departmental metrics, including average ring time, average handling time, a goal of at least 20 online reviews per week (4 per day), and a target of 0 abandoned calls, among other standards.



Desired Qualifications:

- College degree or equivalent work experience.

- Experience with Real Estate is a plus.

- Experience with CINC is a plus.

- At least 6 months of experience working remotely.

- Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written).

- Excellent interpersonal skills, problem solving, and analytical skills.

- Strong customer service skills.

- Ability to multi-task and prioritize.

- Reliable and dependable.

- Excellent problem-solving skills.

- Ability to remain calm under pressure.

- Attention to details and highly organized.

- Great time management skills.

- Capable of keeping control of the call even when the customer is angry.

- Ethical and trustworthy.

- Great at relationship-building.

- Ability to work under minimal supervision.

- Friendly and fair.



Working conditions:

- Candidate must be able to work from 9 am to 5 pm EST.

- Comfortable working with Hubstaff.

- Night shift – Office is in Washington DC under EST.

- Must be available to cover one of the three shifts available (EST: 8 am to 4:30 pm – 9 am to 5:30 pm – 9:30 am to 6 pm).

- The schedules are permanent and assigned by the department’s Manager. Schedules might change eventually depending on demand.

- Must have own work equipment that is not older than 2 years.

- Work equipment must be personal and not a family or shared computer/laptop.

- Internet speed must be no lower than 150 Mbps.

- Must have backup internet for emergencies (no lower than 100 Mbps) and a place to relocate during power or internet outages.



Compensation & Benefits:

- $6 USD per hour.

- PTO after 90 days of probationary period.

- HMO allowance after 90 days of probationary period.

title: Assistant Property Manager
description:
*KINDLY READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION & THE APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY.*



EJF is a property management company headquartered in Washington, DC. We are looking for Assistant Property Managers for our growing team. A successful candidate will enjoy solving problems, is responsible, organized, detail oriented, and reliable.



Role Purpose:



The Associate Community Manager (ACM) is responsible for supporting the Community Association Manager (CAM) in the daily operations, financial oversight, administrative functions, and resident/board communications of assigned associations. The ACM ensures timely execution of operational tasks, accurate financial processing, regulatory compliance, and consistent communication, allowing the CAM to focus on strategic management and board leadership.



Core Responsibilities:



1. Communication & Responsiveness:



Respond to resident, vendor, and internal inquiries within 2 business hours.

Respond to board member requests, concerns, and follow-ups in a timely and professional manner.

Prepare and distribute broadcast
s, notices, and announcements to residents.

Address and escalate property-related issues as appropriate.

Participate in and contribute to daily huddles.

Prepare and send weekly updates.



2. Financial & Accounting Support:



Review and approve invoices.

Ensure monthly utility bills are processed and paid on time.

Review invoice GL coding, descriptions, and amounts for accuracy.

Run General Ledger (GL) reports.

Review monthly financial statements and reclassify mis-coded transactions.

Bill back homeowners for chargeable items.

Submit add-charge requests as required.

Assist the CAM with preparation of annual association budgets.



3. Vendor, Contract & Procurement Support:



Gather and organize existing contracts.

Request bids and proposals from vendors in coordination with the CAM.

Schedule and track annual preventive maintenance.

Assist CAM with Capital Expenditure (CapEx) projects and insurance claim administration.



4. Operations & Work Order Management:



Create and manage work orders and action items in Vantaca or designated systems.

Track completion and follow up on open tasks.

Coordinate move-in and move-out requests.

Address day-to-day operational issues impacting the property.

Key/fobs/clickers and entry systems request.



5. Compliance & Regulatory Tracking:



Support compliance efforts in all service areas by coordinating data collection, documentation, and delivery in partnership with the CAM and Compliance team.



Assist with statutory and jurisdictional requirements, including but not limited to:



Elevator certifications

Energy benchmarking

County registrations

Other jurisdiction-specific filings and inspections

Notify CAM of upcoming deadlines and compliance risks



6. Resale & Homeowner Support:



Assist the resale department by providing additional information and documentation as requested.

Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely responses to resale-related inquiries.



7. Documentation & Systems Management:



File and maintain accurate records in SharePoint and Vantaca including:



Contracts

Compliance records

Correspondence

Inspection reports

Draft letters

Meeting notices, proxies, and related materials

Forms, service tickets,



Ensure documents are properly stored and accessible in Sharepoint and Vantaca.

Follow standardized folder structures, naming conventions, and document retention guidelines.



Authority & Escalation:



ACMs operate within defined approval limits and SOP guidelines.

Strategic decisions, policy changes, and board-level recommendations are escalated to the CAM.

Issues impacting association risk, budget variance, or legal exposure must be escalated promptly.



Performance Expectations & KPIs:



 and inquiry response time: < 2 business hours.

On-time utility payments and invoice processing.

Accuracy of GL coding and financial reporting.

Compliance deadlines met with no lapses.

SOP adherence and training completion.

Positive feedback from CAMs and boards on responsiveness and reliability.



Qualifications:

- Experience in the property management or real estate industry is required.

- At least 1 year of experience in HOA and/or condominium management is required.

title: Business Development Specialist
description:
Position Summary

Our company is seeking a driven, energetic, and results-oriented Business Development Specialist to join our growing sales team. This role is ideal for a confident English communicator who thrives on building relationships, creating opportunities, and generating new business.



As the first point of contact with prospective clients, you will be responsible for conducting high-volume outbound prospecting through cold calling, email, and other outreach strategies. You will make approximately 150 outbound cold calls per day while leveraging HubSpot CRM to manage leads, track activity, and nurture prospects.



You will engage directly with CEOs, business owners, executives, and business brokers, introducing our services, identifying business needs, and scheduling qualified appointments for our sales team. Success in this role requires resilience, professionalism, curiosity, and the ability to build trust quickly through meaningful conversations.



Candidates must possess exceptional spoken and written English communication skills. Previous experience in B2B sales is required.



Key Responsibilities

• Conduct approximately 150 outbound cold calls per day to prospective clients.

• Generate new business opportunities through cold calling, email campaigns, and outbound prospecting.

• Engage CEOs, business owners, executives, and brokers in professional, consultative conversations.

• Present HR Partners' services and value proposition compellingly and professionally.

• Identify customer needs, qualify prospects, and schedule high-quality appointments for the sales team.

• Maintain accurate prospect records, call activity, notes, and follow-up tasks within HubSpot CRM.

• Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through consistent daily outreach.

• Follow established sales processes while achieving daily, weekly, and monthly activity goals.

• Collaborate with the sales team to share market insights and improve prospect engagement strategies.

• Represent HR Partners with professionalism, integrity, and a customer-first mindset.



Qualifications

• Experience using HubSpot CRM or similar customer relationship management software is preferred.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in outbound B2B sales, appointment setting, or business development.

• Demonstrated success in high-volume cold calling and lead generation.

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills with a clear, professional, and confident speaking voice.

• Ability to confidently communicate with C-suite executives, business owners, and decision-makers.

• Strong relationship-building, active listening, and objection-handling skills.

• Self-motivated, resilient, goal-oriented, and comfortable working in a performance-driven environment.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills with strong attention to detail.

• Experience selling HR outsourcing, payroll, benefits, insurance, or other business services is highly preferred.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional, distraction-free home office if working remotely.

• Ability to work during United States Eastern Time business hours.



Work Schedule

• Monday through Friday

• 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST)

• This is a full-time position. Candidates must be available to work during EST business hours.



Performance Expectations

• Complete approximately 150 outbound cold calls each business day.

• Consistently meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly outbound activity and appointment-setting goals.

• Maintain accurate and timely CRM documentation.

• Deliver a professional and engaging customer experience during every interaction.

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified business opportunities.

• Contribute to the continued growth of the sales organization through consistent prospecting and relationship building.



What Success Looks Like

The successful business development specialist is energetic, coachable, highly motivated, and enjoys speaking with new people every day. They are comfortable handling objections, persistent without being pushy, and focused on creating opportunities that help the sales team close new business. They embrace accountability, consistently exceed activity goals, and contribute to the company's long-term growth by generating qualified appointments and fostering strong business relationships.

title: Paid Media Manager - Meta & Google Ads
description:
Paid Media Manager — Meta & Google Ads, Fashion

Remote · Part-time · Independent Contractor

 

Read this first

This role is for someone who has run paid ads for clothing or fashion brands, and who knows how to sell clothing without sales, discounts, countdowns or urgency. If your results have come from promotions, or your experience is mainly lead generation, coaching or dropshipping, this role won't be a fit, and we'd rather say so now.

 

About us

Cocopiña makes feminine clothing for women who love to travel. We're a small US brand and we sell directly to our customers. We shoot all of our own photography and video, so there is a large, organized library to advertise with.

 

Our ads never lead with a discount or a deadline. The ad has to show why the piece is worth buying: the fabric, the fit on a real body, how it's made, what it does across a full day. Reading whether an ad does that is the core of this job.

 

The job

You run our ad accounts and make them better. You d
 what runs, build and launch the ads, replace what has stopped working, and find what is holding performance back.

 

The heart of it is reading creative. You look at how individual ads performed and explain what caused the difference: the hook, the format, the angle, the line, what the frame shows. Then you turn that into a recommendation for what we should run and what we should make next.

 

You won't produce creative or work with influencers. We do want your creative input: angles worth trying, what a hook is missing, what we should shoot next.

 

Tools and process

Our tools are connected, and automated processes pull and analyze account data, including an AI analysis that runs weekly. Part of this job is refining them, and building the systems that keep performance improving rather than relying on anyone's memory of what worked.

 

Each week you report on what you're seeing and set the direction: what should run, what should come off, and what we need to create. You work directly with our creative team, telling them what the account needs and why. Once the creative is produced, you build and launch the ads.

 

Requirements

- You have managed Meta ads for fashion or apparel brands, with real testing experience

- You know how to sell clothing without discounts, sales, countdowns or urgency. We don't run them

- Google Ads experience

- You can explain why one ad beat another. "It got a 4x" is not an explanation

- You can write a recommendation specific enough for us to produce from

- Steady judgment at lower order volumes, where a few unusual days are usually noise

- You work independently. We won't manage the account over your shoulder, and we need someone who runs it without being chased

- Available Mondays, and reliable with a weekly deadline

 

Preferred:

- Triple Whale. It's our source of truth for performance across channels, and we work from it rather than from what each platform reports about itself.

- You have shot, edited, or art-directed ads yourself. People who have made ads read performance differently.

 

Optional: Pinterest or TikTok advertising, and a working understanding of SEO.

 

AI

We use AI for analysis, reporting, and internal work. None of our visuals are AI-generated. Every image and video is shot by us, and we don't use AI to alter or extend our photography.

 

To apply

Apply through OnlineJobs. Start your message with "Without the discount," then answer the four questions below in the message itself.

 

Attach two files:

- Your resume, as a PDF

- Your portfolio, as a PDF: ad work for clothing or fashion brands, with what each ad achieved

 

Applications without both attachments won't be reviewed. Please don't send collections of links, or references to work unrelated to paid advertising for fashion. We review your message and the two files.

 

The four questions:

1. The fashion or apparel brands you've run ads for: the category, the price point, the monthly spend, and your role. If you can't name a brand, describe it.

2. Two ads from a clothing brand where one clearly beat the other. In a few sentences, tell us why: the hook, the format, what the first frame showed, and what the winner proved about the product that the other didn't.

3. One account you improved without a discount or a deadline: what you found, what you changed, how you knew it worked, and which numbers you trusted.

4. Your rate and weekly availability, including Mondays.

title: Product Research Specialist – Fashion Dropshipping (Meta)
description:
We are a fast-growing e-commerce/dropshipping company specializing in the fashion niche, running multiple active stores on Meta 
 & Instagram) and TikTok across Europe and the USA. We already have a Product Research Specialist on our team, but because of our growth we are now looking for an additional person to join them: someone with a strong eye for fashion who can spot winning products early, analyze trends, and work in a structured way to keep our stores ahead of the competition.



Your Role



As our Product Research Specialist, you will find trending, high-potential fashion products for our Meta stores. You will do this by analyzing competitor ads, market trends, and performance data. You will work closely with our product listing and creative teams, so that winning products are spotted quickly and tested fast.



What You’ll Do



Research and identify winning fashion products (clothing, shoes, accessories) for our Meta stores in Europe and the USA

Analyze competitor video ads and stores using
 Ads Library, KoalaData, and other research tools

Spot seasonal and emerging fashion trends early, before they saturate

Evaluate product potential based on ad engagement, scaling signals, and market fit

Keep a structured overview of researched, tested, and winning products across stores

Provide clear reports and recommendations to the team

Collaborate with the product listing and creative teams to align research with campaigns



What We’re Looking For



Proven experience in product research for dropshipping, ideally in the fashion niche

Strong knowledge of the
 Ads Library and how to recognize scaling ads on Meta

Familiarity with tools like KoalaData (TikTok research is a plus)

A good sense of fashion and of what appeals to customers in Europe and the USA

Strong organizational skills to track and oversee multiple stores

Analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive mindset

Full-time availability and eagerness to grow with the company



Why Join Us



Play a key role in discovering the products that drive our sales growth

Join a young, ambitious, and scaling company

Dynamic work environment where your insights matter

Room to grow and bring in your own ideas



How to apply:



Send a WhatsApp message to 
and include:



Your CV

A motivation letter

An introduction video (1–2 min) explaining your experience and why you’re the perfect fit

Your completed research task (see below)



Research task



Find 3 fashion products for Europe and 3 fashion products for the USA that you believe are currently winning on Meta.



Requirements:



Fashion only (clothing, shoes, accessories)

Video ads only, no image ads



For each product, include:



Link to the ad

Link to the store

Why you think this product is winning (which signals you see)

How you found it (which tool, filters, keywords or method you used)



About the task



The research task is unpaid at this stage. However, if you are selected, you will be paid for the task you completed.



We ask for this because we are looking for A-players: people who are truly serious about this role. We are serious about building a great team, and we only want to work with people who are just as serious.



Important



If your application does not include everything listed above (CV, motivation letter, introduction video and the completed research task), we will not respond to it. Period. No exceptions.



Please include the word “Blauw” in your application to confirm that you have read this description carefully.



PS: I only read WhatsApp messages, so if you don’t apply there, I won’t see your application.



Kind regards,

Ruben

title: Sales Representative
description:
# SALES REPRESENTATIVE



### AI Marketing & Business Growth Services | Remote | U.S. Market



**Covered Bridge Brands (CBB)** is building a sales team to introduce an innovative suite of AI-powered marketing and lead-generation solutions to businesses throughout the United States.



We are looking for an **exceptional Filipino sales professional with fluent English** who wants more than a typical VA or appointment-setting position.



This is an opportunity to become part of a growing sales organization where **your ability, performance, and results can directly influence your earning potential and advancement.**



---



## THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone who can start by **prospecting and generating qualified appointments**, but who has the ability and ambition to develop into a **full-cycle sales representative and closer.**



Initially, you will be responsible for:



* Cold calling U.S. business owners

* Introducing CBB and our services

* Identifying businesses that could benefit from our solutions

* Asking effective discovery questions

* Creating interest and establishing value

* Handling initial objections

* Scheduling qualified Google Meet appointments

* Following up with prospects

* Maintaining accurate CRM records



As you become familiar with CBB's services and demonstrate your ability, you will be trained to participate in and eventually conduct **Google Meet sales presentations**.



Your role can evolve from:



**Prospector → Appointment Setter → Sales Representative → Closer**



We are looking for someone who wants to grow into that opportunity.



---



# WHAT YOU WILL SELL



CBB provides a suite of marketing and growth solutions designed to help local businesses:



* Generate more leads

* Attract more customers

* Improve their online presence

* Increase visibility in local search

* Improve their Google Business presence

* Automate marketing and follow-up

* Use AI to improve their marketing and sales processes

* Convert more prospects into customers



You do **not** need to be an expert in these services when you apply.



**We will train the right person.**



What we cannot easily train is **drive, communication ability, curiosity, persistence and the desire to succeed in sales.**



---



# WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



* A **fluent English speaker**

* Confident speaking with U.S. business owners

* Professional and articulate

* Comfortable making outbound cold calls

* Persuasive without being pushy

* A strong listener

* Comfortable asking questions and conducting discovery

* Highly motivated

* Coachable

* Persistent

* Organized

* Comfortable working independently

* Interested in building a long-term sales career



Previous experience in **B2B sales, cold calling, appointment setting, tele sales, digital marketing, SaaS, lead generation or closing** is highly desirable.



Experience selling to the **U.S. market** is a major plus.



---



# WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR...



Someone who simply wants to:



* Read a script all day

* Make calls without caring about the outcome

* Schedule appointments regardless of quality

* Wait for someone else to tell them what to do

* Treat this as just another VA position



We are looking for someone who wants to **learn the business, understand the customer and become a salesperson.**



---



# TRAINING & ADVANCEMENT



You will receive training on:



* CBB's services

* Our target markets

* Prospecting strategies

* Cold calling

* Discovery

* Objection handling

* Sales presentations

* Google Meet sales calls

* CRM and pipeline management

* Follow-up

* Closing



As you demonstrate your ability, you will be given opportunities to take on greater responsibility and higher-value sales conversations.



**We intend to build our sales team from within.**



Exceptional performance will create opportunities for increased responsibility, compensation and advancement.



---



# COMPENSATION



**Salary commensurate with experience, qualifications and demonstrated sales ability, plus performance-based commissions.**



We are much more interested in finding the **right salesperson** than simply finding the least expensive salesperson.



Our compensation structure is designed to reward performance.



---



# WORKING HOURS



This position will primarily involve selling to businesses in the United States.



You must be available to work during **U.S. business hours** and have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A quiet, professional workspace

* A quality computer

* Reliable audio/video equipment

* A professional presence on video calls



---



# APPLICATION PROCESS



We are interested in more than your resume.



If you apply, please provide:



**1. Resume**



**2. Sales experience**



Tell us what you have sold, who you sold to, and whether your experience was primarily appointment setting, sales, closing, or a combination.



**3. A 1–2 minute video introduction**



In English, tell us:



* Who you are

* Your sales experience

* What products or services you have sold

* Your experience with cold calling

* Your experience selling to U.S. customers

* Why you believe you would be successful in this position



**Your video is important.**



We want to hear how you communicate, not simply read what you've written on a resume.



Selected candidates may also be asked to participate in a **live sales role-play** as part of the interview process.



---



# THE RIGHT PERSON



If you are an experienced Filipino sales professional who:



**Speaks excellent English.**



**Is comfortable picking up the phone and making the call.**



**Can handle rejection.**



**Knows how to build rapport.**



**Wants to learn.**



**Wants to earn based on performance.**



**And wants the opportunity to grow into a serious sales role...**



**We want to hear from you.**



### Covered Bridge Brands



**AI Marketing. Real Results.**

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO (Operations)
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO THE CEO (OPERATIONS)

RHS LTD | Remote, Philippines-based | Full-time contract (independent contractor)



ABOUT US

British Supplements is a UK supplement manufacturer and online retailer. We run our own factory, a Shopify Plus store, and a multi-million-pound advertising operation. The business moves quickly and the CEO travels between the UK, Manila and Asia currently.



THE ROLE

This is not an admin job and it's not a job where you wait to be told what to do. You'll be the CEO's right hand: taking things off his plate, getting them finished, and only coming back when a decision genuinely needs him.



He may not speak to you for a week or two. When he does, he expects things done, short answers and a clear recommendation. If you need daily guidance, this role isn't for you.



You could be asked to do almost anything. If it can be done from a laptop or a phone, it's your job.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make calls and hold meetings on the CEO's behalf: vendors, agencies, labs, suppliers, the UK factory team.

- Run the vendor pipeline end to end. Book calls within 48 hours, summarise them the same day, chase once, then close or park. Keep the vendor tracker current so nothing has to be remembered.

- Execute tasks to a rule without asking twice. Example: "Publish every passing lab result on its product page; send me any fails." Done, not discussed.

- Research suppliers, competitors, products, prices, services, venues and travel. Come back with a short answer and a recommendation, not 20 links.

- Edit the Shopify store across 100+ products: product page updates, documents, images and content changes, done accurately and consistently at volume.

- Prepare images and files: download, crop, resize, compress and rename before uploading, so pages stay fast and tidy.

- General online work: setting up accounts, filling in forms, chasing orders and invoices, sorting subscriptions, anything that keeps things moving.

- Handle personal admin: restaurant bookings, travel, drivers, appointments in Manila, the UK and China.

- Bring ideas to the table, with a recommendation and a plan rather than a list of options. Then deliver the task you were given first.

- Could help out other teams, office, SEO/AI team etc.



HOW YOU'LL REPORT

short to the point updates daily via
 and whatsapp. 

- Done

- Calls made: who, outcome, pros and cons, next step

- Needs you: maximum three items, each with your recommendation

- Anything I need to know about that is important.



YOU MUST HAVE

- 3+ years as an executive assistant, chief of staff or operations lead to a founder or CEO.

- Excellent spoken and written English, and a confident, professional phone manner with UK businesses.

- A record of working independently and finishing things. Be ready to give specific examples.

- Hands-on Shopify admin experience, including bulk product edits.

- Comfortable with basic image editing (Canva, Photoshop or similar) and file compression.

- Strong research skills: fast, thorough, and able to tell a good source from a bad one.

- Good judgement: you know what to d
 yourself and what to escalate.

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and backup power.



To show you've read this far, start your application with the words "I'm a go-getter". Applications that don't start this way will be deleted unread.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in e-commerce, supplements, health or consumer brands.

- Mandarin, or experience arranging things in China (WeChat, hotel concierges).

- Familiarity with Klaviyo, Canva, Google Workspace and Slack.



HOURS

4pm to 1am Manila time, covering the UK working day, with a one-hour break between 8pm and 10pm. Reachable on WhatsApp at all times.



PAY AND HOLS

- PHP 90,000 to 120,000 a month, depending on experience, paid on a fixed date each month.

- 15 days' paid leave a year, rising by one day for each full year of service, up to 28. Philippine public holidays are normal working days; any you want off are taken from your allowance. Leave builds up monthly and can be used after three months.

title: Agronomist
description:
MaxPrecision Lab S.R.L. is looking for a person with a background in Agronomy, Agricultural Sciences, or related fields who is interested in applying and expanding their knowledge through product evaluation, scientific analysis, technical communication, and customer support.

We are a biotechnology-related company based in La Paz, Bolivia, dedicated to the distribution of laboratory materials, supplies, reagents, and specialized products.



Previous professional experience is not required. We value a positive attitude, discipline, scientific curiosity, and the ability to learn and apply new knowledge. 



What We Offer

-  Job stability and reliable salary payments.

- Opportunities for professional growth and development in a biotechnology-related company.

- Practical experience in projects involving technical analysis, product evaluation, scientific support, and communication of laboratory applications.

- A collaborative environment that values initiative, fast learning, technical accuracy, and problem-solving.

- International work experience and collaboration with a team based in Bolivia.

- The opportunity to work on-site in La Paz or fully remotely.



Main Responsibilities

- Prepare comparative tables explaining product characteristics, differences, advantages, limitations, and potential applications.

- Analyze technical data sheets, specifications, protocols, and scientific literature related to laboratory products, reagents, and supplies used in agronomy, plant sciences, and related fields.

- Support the review and documentation of laboratory procedures related to agricultural sciences and their applications, identifying areas that require clarification or improvement.

- Coordinate with the company’s team to align scientific activities with customer needs and company objectives.

- Provide ongoing technical support and help answer customer questions about the use, performance, and applications of laboratory products related to agronomy and plant sciences.

- Prepare guides, presentations, videos, and other educational materials for training, and post-sale support, using documentation and records from the laboratory team when appropriate.



Required Profile

- Responsibility, discipline, organization, and attention to detail.

- Analytical ability to compare products, interpret technical information, and develop clear conclusions.

- A customer-oriented mindset and willingness to provide technical support and create useful educational materials.

- Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new methodologies, tools, and work processes.

- Initiative and willingness to suggest improvements and solve problems.



Preferred Background and Qualifications

An educational background in Agronomy, Agricultural Sciences, or related fields is welcome, along with an interest in scientific analysis and laboratory applications.



We also value:

- A strong academic record.

- Knowledge of agronomy, plant pathology, plant physiology, plant biotechnology, or laboratory techniques applied to agricultural sciences.

- Familiarity with reading scientific papers, technical data sheets, and laboratory protocols.

- Academic or personal projects related to this field or to other areas.



Tell Us Where You Have Excelled

If you have received recognition or commendations for your performance, graduated with honors or academic distinction, won competitions, medals, or awards, or accomplished something you are proud of, you are welcome to share it in your application.



Achievements both within and outside your field of study are relevant, including academic, professional, scientific, entrepreneurial, sports, or extracurricular activities. Tell us what you achieved, your contribution, and what you learned. You may include certificates or other evidence of your achievements.



Workplace

Work arrangement: on-site or fully remote.

Office location: MaxPrecision Lab S.R.L., La Paz, Bolivia.

Address: Pasoskanqui Building, Offices 7 and 9, between Pasoskanqui Street and Brasil Avenue, Miraflores, La Paz, Bolivia.

This seat makes sure they do. You'll spend your days in Trybe, on TikTok and Instagram finding creators and messaging them, and in a tracker that shows where every conversation stands. Our Community Manager d
 who we want and what we say; you do the reaching out, every day, at volume.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Outreach

Inbound and handoff



- Answer creators who message us about the program within a day.

Tracking and the weekly report



- Every contact in the tracker with a stage, a date and a next step, so anyone could pick up any conversation.

title: Operational Growth Marketer /  Digital Marketer VA
description:
Job Role: Operational Growth Marketer /  Digital Marketer VA



Rate: $1,000.00 per month (for an exceptional candidate)

Work Schedule: Full-time: 8 hours per day, 40 hours per week - PST

Requirement: Minimum 2 years of proven digital marketing experience



About the Role

We are looking for a commercially minded digital marketer with strong systems thinking, AI curiosity, and technical problem-solving ability to help us improve how our agency operates and delivers work.

This is not a pure channel-specialist role, and it is not a narrow automation role.

You do not need to be the best Meta buyer, Google specialist, or WordPress developer in the business. But you do need enough broad digital marketing experience to understand what great delivery should look like, where time is being lost, where workflows are inefficient, and how better systems, tools, and AI-enabled ways of working can improve outcomes.

This role exists to create operational capacity across the agency, reduce unnecessary founder dependency, and help us build smarter ways of delivering websites, landing pages, content, campaigns, and related digital marketing work.



Mission

Create operational capacity and delivery leverage by identifying, prioritizing, and implementing better ways of delivering digital marketing work across the agency, while progressively reducing founder dependency in operational problem-solving.



What You'll Be Responsible For

You will be responsible for helping us improve the way work gets done across the agency. That includes:

* Identifying inefficient processes, bottlenecks, handoffs, and unnecessary complexity

* Spotting opportunities to simplify, systemise, automate, or redesign delivery workflows

* Using AI and other tools to prototype and implement better ways of working

* Improving how websites, landing pages, content, and campaigns are planned and produced

* Documenting improved workflows, templates, and operating procedures

* Working across teams to help improvements get adopted in practice

* Taking ownership of selected operational improvement priorities without needing constant direction

* Bringing recommendations, not just observations, when problems or opportunities appear



The goal is not simply more activity; the goal is to reduce dependency and increase independent execution.



What This Role Is Not

To avoid confusion, this role is not:

A pure automation specialist

A junior technician waiting for instructions

A senior developer hired to custom-build everything

A narrow paid media or SEO specialist

A project coordinator who escalates every important decision upward

We are looking for someone in the middle ground: a strong digital marketer who understands the work commercially and strategically, but who is also curious and capable enough to research, test, improve, and implement smarter operational approaches.



What Success Looks Like

1. Founder capacity is returned. You progressively take ownership of meaningful operational improvement areas so the founder is no longer the default person identifying and driving every improvement opportunity.

2. Delivery workflows improve. You identify and implement practical improvements that reduce friction, handoffs, delays, or unnecessary manual work across delivery.

3. AI is applied commercially, not just creatively. You use AI and automation where it creates genuine leverage, while avoiding unnecessary complexity, overengineering, or custom builds that do not justify themselves.

4. Better systems get adopted by the team. You do not just experiment in isolation. You help translate good ideas into repeatable ways of working the team can actually use.

5. Operational improvements create measurable value. Within a reasonable period, your work should begin freeing capacity, reducing wasted time, improving throughput, supporting retention, enabling new service capability, and/or creating stronger commercial performance.



Key Outcomes for the First 6 Months

* In your first 6 months, you will be expected to:

* Take independent ownership of 2–3 meaningful operational improvement priorities

* Implement 1–2 meaningful workflow improvements per month after ramp-up

* Reduce founder involvement in selected operational areas through clearer ownership and better systems

* Document and roll out at least 3 core workflows, templates, or SOPs

* Demonstrate measurable time savings, reduced handoffs, improved throughput, or other clear operational leverage

* Consistently bring commercially sound recommendations on whether to eliminate, simplify, automate, delegate, or build

* Skills and Experience We're Looking For



Essential

* Broad hands-on digital marketing experience across multiple areas such as websites, landing pages, content, campaign execution, reporting, and client delivery

* Strong ability to understand marketing problems before proposing technical solutions

* Systems thinking: the ability to see workflows, bottlenecks, dependencies, and handoffs

* Confidence using AI tools and modern software to research, prototype, and improve workflows

* Strong problem-solving ability and comfort figuring things out independently

* Ability to recommend the simplest viable solution rather than defaulting to custom complexity

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Strong ownership mentality and follow-through



Marketing Technology Understanding

You do not need to be our best Google Ads or Meta Ads strategist, but you do need to understand digital marketing well enough to work confidently with systems such as:

* Meta Ads / Lead Ads

* Google Ads

* GA4

* Google Tag Manager

* CRM / lead-management systems

* Website forms

* Marketing feeds

* Reporting platforms



Without that context, it would be difficult to properly understand what we are trying to accomplish, where the operational friction sits, and how improved systems should support the marketing outcome.



Technologies / Experience That Would Be Particularly Useful

Strong preference for experience with:

* Google Sheets

* Supermetrics or similar data connectors

* Google Apps Script or comparable scripting experience

* APIs, JSON, and webhooks

* Automation platforms such as Make, n8n, or similar

* AI tools and AI-assisted development

* Data manipulation and reporting

* AI-assisted or low-code application building



Useful but not essential:

* GA4 and Google Tag Manager

* Meta Ads / Google Ads platform knowledge

* SQL

* Python

* Looker Studio or similar reporting tools

* Web scraping / structured data extraction

* CRM and lead-management integrations



Individual technologies matter less than the person's ability to understand systems, learn new tools quickly, and reliably solve the underlying business problem.



Valuable but Not Required

* Experience improving agency delivery operations

* Experience documenting SOPs, templates, and workflows

* Experience working across marketing and web delivery teams

* Familiarity with no-code or low-code automation tools

* Experience implementing AI-assisted production workflows



Competencies

For this role, the competencies that predict success are:

* Digital marketing judgment — understands what good marketing delivery looks like

* Marketing technology understanding — understands the tools and systems surrounding tracking, lead flow, reporting, and campaign execution

* Systems thinking — sees the process behind the task

* Ownership mentality — acts on opportunities instead of waiting to be told

* Commercial judgment — knows when to remove, simplify, buy, or build

* Technical curiosity — explores tools, AI, and new methods with initiative

* Implementation follow-through — can take an idea through to adoption

* Clear communication — explains problems, options, and recommendations simply



Values and Operating Style

* We are looking for someone who:

* Takes ownership instead of waiting for perfect instructions

* Communicates clearly and proactively

* Uses judgment rather than chasing hype

* Prefers practical solutions over clever complexity

* Looks for leverage, not just activity

* Is comfortable working in ambiguity while still moving things forward



How You'll Approach the Work

* In this role, strong performance will usually look like:

* Understanding the commercial and delivery context before changing a workflow

* Questioning whether a task should exist at all before automating it

* Using existing tools where they are good enough

* Building custom solutions only where the value clearly justifies it

* Turning useful experiments into repeatable operational improvements

* Helping the team adopt better ways of working, not just creating isolated founder-side shortcuts



Why This Role Matters

We believe AI may significantly change how digital marketing services are delivered, especially in areas like websites, landing pages, content production, and workflow execution.



The opportunity is bigger than automating small tasks. The real opportunity is redesigning how work gets done so that fewer handoffs are required, capable marketers can do more directly, and the agency becomes more efficient and adaptable.



We need someone who can help identify and implement those opportunities in a practical, commercially responsible way.



Who This Role Would Suit

This role is likely a strong fit for someone who:

* Has 2+ years of real digital marketing experience

* Enjoys improving how work gets done, not just executing tasks

* Is excited by AI and emerging tools, but not distracted by hype

* Can bridge strategy, delivery, systems, and implementation

* Wants to take meaningful ownership in a growing agency environment

* Is motivated by making an operation smarter, simpler, and more scalable



Important:

*Only applicants who meet the requirements will be considered.

*Make sure your resume and portfolio are updated, as these will be the main basis for screening.

*Include examples of operational improvements, workflow redesigns, AI-enabled solutions, or process changes you have identified and implemented, along with any relevant case studies or examples of systems/process work.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Luxury Automotive Reels & Instagram Stories
description:
Supreme Wraps Orlando is a premium automotive customization and protection company specializing in paint protection film (PPF), window tint, vehicle wraps, commercial wraps and other automotive services.



We regularly work with Ferrari, McLaren, Lamborghini, Porsche, Tesla and other premium vehicles.



We're looking for a long-term short-form video editor who can take raw iPhone footage from our shop and transform it into polished, high-retention Instagram Reels and Stories.



This is not simply a cutting-and-trimming position.



We want someone who understands social-media storytelling and viewer retention and can look at raw footage, identify the story, create a strong opening hook, select the best clips and turn them into content people actually want to watch.



What you'll be responsible for

- Editing 15–45 second Instagram Reels

- Creating Instagram Stories from existing footage

- Finding the strongest 1–3 second opening shot

- Developing text/video hooks when appropriate

- Creating alternate hooks for Trial Reels

- Selecting the strongest clips from raw footage

- Color correcting and grading automotive footage

- Working with Apple Log footage when supplied

- Creating clean animated captions and typography

- Music selection

- Automotive sound design

- Speed ramps and transitions when appropriate

- Creating before/after transformations

- Creating educational and talking-head content

- Exporting everything ready to upload to Instagram

- Maintaining a consistent Supreme Wraps visual identity



Our goal is premium—not over-edited.



Ferraris and McLarens should look cinematic and sophisticated. We do not want every video filled with unnecessary transitions, effects or giant animated captions.



You'll receive footage involving:



Ferrari • McLaren • Lamborghini • Porsche • Tesla • BMW • Mercedes-Benz • Corvette • luxury/exotic vehicles • PPF installations • window tint • color-change wraps • commercial vehicle wraps • customer testimonials • before/after transformations • behind-the-scenes footage



You'll also receive footage of the owner speaking directly to camera.



Your job is to turn those assets into compelling social content.



Software

Experience with one or more of the following is required: Adobe Premiere Pro • DaVinci Resolve • After Effects • CapCut



Experience properly grading Apple Log footage is strongly preferred. 



What we're looking for:

You should understand that a successful Reel isn't simply a beautiful video.



It needs to make someone stop scrolling.



You should understand concepts such as:



Hooks → curiosity → retention → payoff → CTA



For example, instead of starting a video with:

“Today we're installing PPF on this Ferrari…”



You should recognize that something such as:

“You probably haven't seen one of these in person yet.” could be a substantially stronger opening.



We're looking for someone who thinks this way.



Compensation

Starting target: $6–$8 USD/hour



Approximately 15–20 hours per week initially, with the potential to increase hours and compensation if the relationship works well.



We're looking for a long-term team member, not someone to complete a few videos and disappear.



Application instructions

Please do NOT send a generic application.



Start your application with the words:

“PERFECTION HAS A FINAL STEP...SUPREME WRAPS”



Then answer the following:

1. Send links to your 3 best short-form videos.

2. Send your best automotive video, if you have one.

3. What do you think makes someone stop scrolling during the first 3 seconds of a Reel?

4. What software do you primarily edit in?

5. Can you properly color-grade Apple Log footage?

6. Do you use DaVinci Resolve?

7. How would you approach editing a Ferrari differently from an ordinary vehicle?

8. How many 20–40 second Reels could you realistically produce each week?

9. What is your hourly rate?

10. Are you willing to complete a paid editing test using our raw footage?



Applications that don't begin with “PERFECTION HAS A FINAL STEP...SUPREME WRAPS” will not be considered.

description:

## About EverHope Press



EverHope Press is a growing Christian publishing brand with 38+ books on Amazon, focused on helping women navigate anxiety, overthinking, stress, burnout, and life's challenges through faith.



We already have an established team managing different areas of our business, including content operations, affiliate marketing, and business operations. We're now expanding our marketing efforts to Instagram.

Our main inspiration is the Instagram account 
 study this account before applying.

 do you like about their content strategy, and how would you adapt it for EverHope Press?

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Company: Sones Accountancy Services Ltd

Location: Remote 

Position: Bookkeeper

Working Hours: To be agreed, with some overlap with UK business hours

Salary: Competitive, depending on experience

Experience: Minimum 2 years' professional bookkeeping experience

Software: Xero experience essential



About Us



Sones Accountancy Services Ltd is a growing, award-winning UK accountancy practice specialising in supporting businesses in the landscaping, construction and trades industries.



Our mission is simple: to help business owners truly understand their numbers so they can make better financial decisions and build successful, profitable businesses.



We pride ourselves on providing a professional service with a personal approach, combining accurate financial information with modern technology and efficient processes.



We are passionate about innovation and use cloud accounting software, automation and AI to make bookkeeping as efficient and accurate as possible.



We are looking for an experienced, reliable and detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our team remotely from the Philippines.



This is a bookkeeping-focused position. You will work alongside our UK-based team to maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records for a portfolio of clients.



Key Responsibilities



1. Day-to-Day Bookkeeping



Maintain accurate and up-to-date bookkeeping records for multiple UK business clients using Xero.



Process and categorise purchase invoices, sales invoices, receipts and other financial transactions.



Ensure transactions are allocated to the correct nominal ledger accounts.



Identify and correct incorrectly coded transactions.



Maintain accurate supplier and customer records.



Process credit notes and ensure they are correctly allocated.



Review transactions for duplicates, missing information and inconsistencies.



Ensure bookkeeping records are maintained in accordance with our internal procedures and deadlines.



2. Bank and Credit Card Reconciliations



Reconcile bank accounts in Xero regularly.



Match bank transactions to the correct invoices, bills and payments.



Reconcile credit card accounts and other payment accounts.



Investigate and resolve unreconciled transactions.



Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions and unusual entries.



Review outstanding bank reconciliation items and ensure they are resolved promptly.



Check that bank balances agree with supporting statements.



Escalate unexplained discrepancies to the UK team rather than making unsupported adjustments.



3. Purchase Ledger Management



Process supplier invoices and credit notes using Xero and our document capture software.



Review invoices for completeness and accuracy.



Check supplier details, invoice dates, amounts and VAT treatment.



Identify potential duplicate invoices.



Allocate costs to the appropriate expense or cost-of-sales accounts.



Match supplier payments against outstanding bills.



Review aged payables and investigate old or incorrectly allocated balances.



Identify missing supplier invoices and request clarification through the appropriate team member.



Maintain a clean and accurate purchase ledger.



4. Sales Ledger Management



Record and reconcile customer invoices, credit notes and receipts.



Allocate customer payments against the correct invoices.



Investigate unallocated receipts and overpayments.



Review outstanding customer balances.



Identify discrepancies between sales invoices and customer payments.



Assist with reconciling payments received through platforms such as Stripe, GoCardless and other payment providers, where applicable.



Ensure the sales ledger is accurate and up to date.



5. UK VAT Bookkeeping



Apply appropriate UK VAT codes to transactions in Xero, following our documented procedures.



Understand the difference between standard-rated, zero-rated, exempt and outside-the-scope transactions.



Check purchase invoices for appropriate VAT documentation.



Identify potentially incorrect VAT coding.



Assist with preparing bookkeeping records for VAT return reviews.



Investigate discrepancies and missing documentation.



Flag unusual VAT transactions to the UK team for review.



Please note: You will not be responsible for providing UK tax advice or independently approving VAT returns. These responsibilities remain with our UK-based team.



6. Document Processing and Automation



We use technology extensively to streamline our bookkeeping processes.



You will be expected to:



Process documents through our document capture and automation systems, including Apron.



Review information extracted automatically from invoices and receipts.



Check that supplier names, dates, invoice numbers, VAT and amounts are correct.



Ensure supporting documents are attached to transactions in Xero.



Identify and correct errors made by automated systems.



Monitor outstanding or unprocessed documents.



Use automation and AI tools in accordance with company procedures.



Suggest improvements to make our bookkeeping processes more efficient.



We are particularly interested in someone who is comfortable working with modern technology and understands that automation still requires careful checking.



7. Job and Project Costing



Many of our clients operate in the landscaping and construction industries, so accurate job costing is important.



Responsibilities may include:



Allocating purchases and expenses to the correct projects or jobs.



Checking that materials, subcontractor costs and other direct expenses are correctly classified.



Using tracking categories or project references where required.



Identifying transactions that have not been allocated to a project.



Helping maintain accurate financial information for job profitability reporting.



8. Balance Sheet Reconciliations and Bookkeeping Quality Checks



Assist with reconciling control accounts and balance sheet balances.



Review outstanding supplier and customer balances.



Identify unusual balances and transactions.



Investigate suspense accounts and incorrectly posted transactions.



Check for duplicate entries and missing transactions.



Assist with reconciling payment clearing accounts.



Review bookkeeping records for completeness before month-end.



Use Xero reports and quality-control software, including Xenon Connect, to identify errors and inconsistencies.



Document outstanding queries and escalate matters requiring further review.



9. Month-End Bookkeeping



Ensure all relevant transactions are entered and reconciled.



Review bank and credit card reconciliations.



Check outstanding invoices, bills and unallocated payments.



Ensure supporting documents are attached where required.



Review transactions for incorrect coding or missing VAT information.



Complete assigned month-end bookkeeping checklists.



Highlight outstanding issues to the UK client manager.



Ensure client records are ready for management accounts preparation or further review.



You will not be responsible for independently preparing management accounts, year-end accounts or corporation tax returns.



10. Task Management and Communication



Manage bookkeeping tasks across multiple clients.



Follow our documented standard operating procedures (SOPs).



Update task progress using our internal practice management systems.



Maintain clear records of completed work and outstanding queries.



Communicate regularly with the UK team.



Raise questions promptly when information is missing or unclear.



Meet agreed daily, weekly and monthly deadlines.



Take ownership of assigned tasks and follow them through to completion.



Maintain strict confidentiality regarding client financial information.



Essential Skills and Experience



We are looking for someone who has:



At least 2 years of professional bookkeeping experience.



Strong practical experience using Xero.



Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple clients or businesses.



Excellent bank reconciliation skills.



Experience processing purchase and sales invoices.



A good understanding of double-entry bookkeeping.



Experience reconciling supplier and customer accounts.



Good knowledge of balance sheet accounts and bookkeeping controls.



Excellent attention to detail.



Strong organisational and time-management skills.



Good written and spoken English.



The ability to work independently while following established procedures.



Confidence identifying errors and investigating discrepancies.



A reliable internet connection and suitable remote working environment.



Previous experience working for a UK accountancy practice.



Experience bookkeeping for UK limited companies.



Knowledge of UK VAT.



Desirable Experience



The following would be advantageous:



Experience with Apron, Dext, Hubdoc or similar document capture software.



Experience using Xenon Connect.



Familiarity with construction, landscaping or trades businesses.



Experience with job costing and project tracking.



Experience working with automation and AI-assisted bookkeeping systems.



Experience working remotely with an overseas team.



The Person We're Looking For



Technical skills are important, but attitude and attention to detail are equally important to us.



Our ideal candidate will be:



Accurate: You take pride in producing clean, reliable bookkeeping records and check your work carefully.



Proactive: You identify problems and raise them rather than waiting for someone else to discover them.



Organised: You can manage multiple clients and deadlines without losing track of outstanding tasks.



Accountable: You take ownership of your work and communicate openly if something is delayed or unclear.



Tech-savvy: You enjoy learning new systems and finding more efficient ways of working.



A team player: You work collaboratively, communicate clearly and are happy to ask questions when needed.



Committed to improvement: You welcome feedback and actively look for opportunities to develop your skills.



We are not looking for someone who simply enters transactions without checking them. We want someone who understands bookkeeping, recognises when something doesn't look right and takes responsibility for maintaining accurate records.



What We Offer



The opportunity to work with an established and growing UK accountancy practice.



A supportive and friendly UK-based team.



Clear processes, checklists and structured workflows.



Access to modern cloud accounting and automation software.



Training on our internal systems and procedures.



Opportunities to develop your bookkeeping and technology skills.



A long-term working relationship for the right person.



How to Apply



To help us identify candidates with the right experience, please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction explaining your bookkeeping experience.



Details of your experience using Xero, including how many years you have used it.



Whether you have previously worked with UK clients or a UK accountancy practice.



The number of clients or businesses you have managed bookkeeping for simultaneously.



Your experience with bank reconciliations, VAT coding and month-end bookkeeping.



Any experience using document capture software or bookkeeping automation.



Your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos (PHP).



Your availability and preferred working hours.



Please also answer this practical question:



You are reconciling a client's bank account in Xero and notice that the bank balance agrees with the statement, but there are several old outstanding supplier invoices and a duplicate expense. What steps would you take to investigate and resolve these issues?



We are looking for someone who can demonstrate practical bookkeeping knowledge, strong attention to detail and a genuine interest in becoming part of our team.



We look forward to hearing from you!



Sones Accountancy Services Ltd

Professional Service. Personal Approach.

description:
Job Overview:

Are you an experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) product researcher looking to level up your career into Wholesale sourcing?



We are a UK-based eCommerce agency hiring on behalf of our US and UK based clients who are expanding into Wholesale. We are looking for a sharp, dedicated Product Sourcing Virtual Assistant with a solid background in Online Arbitrage (US or UK marketplace).



Don't have deep wholesale experience yet? 

That’s completely fine! As long as you already know how to analyze Amazon data, read Keepa charts, and evaluate deals like a pro, we've got the rest covered:



100% Free Training: Full, step-by-step guidance on wholesale product analysis and supplier sourcing.

Tools Provided: We supply your Keepa and SellerAmp (SAS) accounts during training.

All we ask from you: Your time, dedication and commitment to learn.



Key Responsibilities:



Scan and evaluate large wholesale/distributor product catalogs to find high-margin, profitable items.

Deep-dive into product viability using Keepa (Buy Box share, price stability, historical sales velocity, review trends, and FBA competition).



Identify potential brands and distributors for wholesale accounts.



Calculate net margins, landed costs, prep fees and Amazon FBA fees accurately.



Check brand restrictions, IP claim risks, hazmat and ungating eligibility.



Maintain organized lead sheets and supplier logs.



Requirements & Qualifications:



Proven OA Experience: At least 6+ months of actual, hands-on experience doing product research in Online Arbitrage (Amazon US or UK marketplace). (Must understand BSR, Buy Box logic, seller counts, and fees).



Keepa Mastery: Strong ability to read and interpret Keepa charts accurately (not just looking at current rank/price).



Tools Knowledge: Experience with tools like SellerAmp (SAS), RevSeller, IP Alert, or ScanUnlimited / wholesale scanner software (or willingness to learn).



Eager to Learn: Excited to learn and master the Wholesale business model through our guided training and SOPs.

Work Setup: Stable PC/laptop, reliable high-speed internet connection (with backup power/data), and active communication via Slack/WhatsApp/Email.



High attention to detail, honesty, and analytical thinking.



What We Offer:

Base Salary: $500 USD/month (can go higher based on experience and proven track record).



Free In-House Training: Complete step-by-step training and SOPs on Wholesale sourcing, catalog analysis, and brand qualification.

description:
Leading With Heart is looking for a Branding Strategist to set the brand direction for our executive coaching and leadership development firm and make our brand more recognizable and memorable.

We are developing a recurring brand character built around leadership, workplace behavior, and communication. We already have an existing social media team and video production support, so this role will focus on brand strategy, positioning, storytelling, and creative direction, working alongside that team rather than producing day-to-day content.



Responsibilities

• Define the overall Leading With Heart brand strategy, positioning, and voice.

• Lead the creative direction, personality, and story of a recurring brand character.

• Develop brand guidelines that keep messaging and visuals consistent across channels.

• Guide our existing social media team on how the brand should show up across platforms and audiences.

• Shape campaign concepts and brand storytelling that make the firm easier to recognize and remember.

• Explore how the brand character can extend into other brand assets, such as merchandise.

• Align the brand with our offerings, including assessments, managed coaching, and our leadership programs.

• Brand strategy and positioning

• Creative direction and brand storytelling

• Character- or mascot-driven branding

• Working alongside existing marketing and social media teams

Experience with character-driven, mascot, or story-based branding is a strong advantage. This is not a content creation or video editing role; we are looking for someone who can lead the brand strategy and creative direction behind our content.

title: AMAZON UK ONLINE ARBITRAGE (OA) PRODUCT RESEARCHER

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday

Working Hours: 8 hours per day / 40 hours per week

Monthly Salary: ₱30,000

Location: Remote / Work From Home



We are looking for an experienced and reliable Amazon UK Online Arbitrage Product Researcher who can consistently source profitable, buyable products that meet our strict sourcing criteria.

We are looking for someone who understands the UK Amazon marketplace, knows how to use product research tools, and can deliver quality leads consistently.

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Working Hours: 8 hours per day

Total Working Hours: 40 hours per week

Submission Deadline: 5:00 PM Philippine Time

Daily KPI: Minimum of 5 APPROVED leads per day

Saturday and Sunday are rest days. No work is required during weekends.

Please understand that our target is 5 approved leads per day, not simply 5 submitted leads. Quality, accuracy, and consistency are essential.



3. SALARY & PAYMENT

Payment Schedule: Every 15th and 30th of the month

Payment through Wise

We will evaluate actual research output, not just the number of hours claimed.

Applicants must be honest about their experience and capabilities.



DO NOT FAKE YOUR EXPERIENCE. We value honesty, accountability, and genuine product research skills. It is better to be honest about your capabilities than to claim experience you do not have.

At least 1 year of actual experience in Amazon UK Online Arbitrage product research.

title: SEO & AEO Specialist
description:
We're looking for someone who takes ownership of results, not just deliverables.



Key Responsibilities



SEO Strategy & Organic Performance

- Own and execute SEO strategies for approximately 3–5 client websites.

- Take responsibility for improving keyword rankings, organic visibility, qualified traffic, and overall SEO performance.

- Conduct comprehensive website audits to identify technical, structural, and content-related opportunities.

- Perform keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent research to identify ranking opportunities.

- Develop and execute ongoing SEO action plans based on performance data and business objectives.

- Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, search visibility, and conversions, making proactive recommendations and adjustments.

- Identify ranking declines and performance issues, investigate potential causes, and implement solutions.



On-Page & Technical SEO

- Optimize existing website pages, including title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H6 headings, URLs, image alt text, and internal linking.

- Identify and resolve technical SEO issues involving crawlability, indexability, redirects, canonical tags, broken links, XML sitemaps, and site structure.

- Implement structured data and schema markup where appropriate.

- Monitor Core Web Vitals and page performance, collaborating with developers when technical support is required.

- Identify opportunities to improve website architecture, navigation, and internal linking.

- Implement SEO updates directly within WordPress and Shopify.

- Regularly audit existing pages and identify opportunities to improve rankings through content refreshes and on-page enhancements.



SEO, AEO & AI-Assisted Content

- Develop SEO-focused content strategies aligned with keyword opportunities, search intent, and client business goals.

- Write, edit, and optimize blog posts, landing pages, product pages, and other website content.

- Apply Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) best practices to improve visibility in AI-powered search experiences.

- Confidently use AI tools, including ChatGPT, to accelerate content research, creation, and optimization.

- Fact-check, edit, and refine AI-assisted content to ensure accuracy, originality, strong brand alignment, and editorial quality.

- Structure content to support both traditional search rankings and AI-powered discovery.

- Ensure all content is optimized before publication.



Reporting & Continuous Optimization

- Track SEO performance using Google Search Console, GA4, and professional SEO tools.

- Monitor keyword ranking movements, organic traffic trends, indexing issues, and organic conversions.

- Provide clear performance updates explaining what was accomplished, what changed, and what actions should happen next.

- Proactively recommend new strategies and optimizations based on performance data.

- Focus on measurable progress rather than simply reporting completed tasks.



Project Management & Accountability

- Independently manage SEO activities, content calendars, and deliverables across 3–5 clients.

- Develop and maintain organized SEO roadmaps with clear priorities and deadlines.

- Take full ownership of deadlines without needing constant reminders or oversight.

- Prioritize activities based on their potential impact on organic performance.

- Communicate proactively about progress, blockers, and recommendations.

- Coordinate with developers, designers, and other team members when necessary to implement SEO improvements.

- Ensure SEO initiatives consistently move forward without waiting for management to assign every task.



Qualifications

- Proven experience managing SEO strategy and execution for multiple websites.

- Strong understanding of technical SEO, on-page SEO, content optimization, and keyword ranking strategies.

- Demonstrated experience improving organic rankings and traffic through hands-on SEO execution.

- Knowledge of current AEO/GEO best practices and evolving AI-powered search experiences.

- Experience using AI tools to create, research, edit, and optimize SEO content.

- Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, and SEO platforms such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Screaming Frog.

- Hands-on experience with WordPress and Shopify.

- Understanding of structured data, website architecture, internal linking, and technical SEO fundamentals.

- Excellent English writing, editing, and communication skills.

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn performance data into actionable recommendations.

- Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to independently manage multiple accounts.
