title: Escalation Tech Engineer
description:
Escalation Tech Engineer

Job Advert

Full-Time Remote-First

Salary: $10 - $13 (Depends on experience)



The challenge



Every managed service provider has the same quiet problem. The clever engineer becomes the person everything gets thrown at, spends their week doing work three other people could have done, and never gets the two uninterrupted hours it would take to work out why the same fault keeps coming back. So, it keeps coming back. For years. We have built this seat specifically to stop that happening here.

It is protected. As our band structure is implemented, band technicians will not escalate directly to you. Escalations will follow a defined approval path through the Project / Account Manager, ensuring routine issues remain with the appropriate technicians while genuinely complex problems reach you. Your manager's job description explicitly includes defending your thinking time. And you are measured on repeat i
 eliminated, not tickets closed, which is a deliberate choice about what we want you to optimize for.



The role



You are the technical escalation point for the company. When the support team has exhausted the normal troubleshooting path, the problem comes to you. As our technician band structure is introduced, this role will sit above those bands as the technical escalation point for issues they cannot resolve. The immediate priority is restoring service safely, especially when a healthcare facility has a critical system unavailable, and residents or staff are depending on it. You need to be comfortable troubleshooting under pressure, including with a client on the phone, without losing your ability to think clearly. But getting things working again is only the beginning.

Once the issue is stabilized, you determine why it happened. You hypothesize, isolate, gather evidence, test, and prove the root cause rather than settling for a plausible explanation. From there, you determine whether the same condition exists elsewhere, permanently correct it, improve the documentation, or work with our Cloud Automation Engineers where automation can eliminate the problem altogether. Firefight → Root Cause → Pattern → Permanent Fix. You will also own complex networking work, from troubleshooting existing environments to designing, building, provisioning, configuring, deploying, validating, and documenting networks for new clients, new locations, and network refreshes.

You will also help raise the technical capability of the support team. Through monthly knowledge sessions, you will walk technicians through difficult issues, your troubleshooting approach, what the evidence showed, and how similar problems should be handled in the future. As the band structure is introduced, that knowledge transfer will help raise the technical ceiling within each band. Some issues will inevitably reach you that should have been resolved before escalation. Your job is to identify what was missed, return the escalation when appropriate, and help technicians build the knowledge needed, so the same type of issue does not need to reach you again.

That keeps bands in the vision but makes it honest that you're transitioning toward that structure rather than already operating under it.



What you will actually do



• Resolve complex escalations: Own difficult technical issues that have exhausted the normal support troubleshooting path.

• Take command during severity i
: When a serious technical i
 occurs, lead the technical response, establish priorities, coordinate troubleshooting, and drive service restoration.

• Find the real cause: Hypothesize, isolate, test and prove. Clearly distinguish between what the evidence confirms, what you are inferring, and what is still unknown.

• Own complex network escalations: Troubleshoot network connectivity, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VLAN and related infrastructure problems through root cause and permanent resolution.

• Design and build client networks: Design, provision, configure, deploy and validate network environments for new clients, new locations and network refreshes.

• Configure network infrastructure: Work hands-on with firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points, VLANs, routing, DHCP, DNS and other network services required to deliver reliable client environments.

• Own Microsoft 365 escalations: Investigate complex Microsoft 365, Entra ID, identity, authentication, access and cloud-related issues that the support team cannot resolve.

• Document root cause: Major i
 should leave behind clear technical documentation explaining what happened, how it was proven, what resolved it, and what needs to change permanently.

• Look for patterns: When an issue repeats, investigate whether it points to a larger systemic problem rather than treating every occurrence as an unrelated ticket.

• Engineer workarounds when necessary: When permanent remediation cannot happen immediately, develop a safe workaround that restores service while ensuring the permanent correction remains tracked.

• Feed the automation pipeline: Identify repetitive and systemic technical problems that should be eliminated through automation and work with our Cloud Automation Engineers to make that happen.

• Improve documentation: Turn difficult i
 and discoveries into useful technical documentation, KBs, standards and troubleshooting guidance.

• Teach the support team: Lead monthly technical knowledge sessions based on real escalations and recurring issues so the team's troubleshooting capability continues to improve.

• Return incomplete escalations: When required troubleshooting or documentation has not been completed, return the escalation with clear direction on what is missing.

• Support new-client onboarding: Provide senior technical input where network, infrastructure, Microsoft 365 or other complex technical requirements need to be understood, redesigned or implemented.





Who we are looking for



You are genuinely curious about why things break.

A solution that suddenly starts working again without anyone understanding why should bother you.

When something fails, you want evidence.

You naturally separate what you know from what you suspect. You form a hypothesis, test it, eliminate possibilities and adjust your approach when the evidence proves your original assumption wrong.

You are equally comfortable troubleshooting a problem that already exists and building an environment correctly from the beginning.

You can move between Microsoft 365, networking, infrastructure and applications without assuming that the symptom necessarily identifies the layer where the actual problem exists.

You are comfortable being hands-on. Your networking experience is not limited to recommending products, creating diagrams or handing a design to somebody else. You understand how networks are actually configured, deployed, tested and troubleshot.

You remain composed when the situation is serious.

When logs are incomplete, users are down and a client wants an answer immediately, you can clearly explain what is known, what is being investigated and what happens next without guessing.

And you finish.

Root-cause work frequently happens after the emergency is over. Nobody may be standing over you asking why yesterday's i
 occurred. You still go back, complete the investigation, document it, identify the pattern and make sure the permanent work gets done.

Otherwise, this role becomes another level of support. That is not what we are building.



YOU WILL NEED



• Deep hands-on diagnostic experience across infrastructure, networking, cloud and application layers

• Proven hands-on Microsoft 365 troubleshooting experience

• Proven hands-on networking experience, including both troubleshooting and implementation

• Experience designing, building, provisioning and configuring business networks

• Strong working knowledge of firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing and network security

• The ability to troubleshoot across multiple layers rather than assuming the first apparent cause is the real one

• A structured troubleshooting methodology you can clearly explain, including how you isolate variables and prove root cause

• Strong i
-management instincts and the ability to remain calm during live client-impacting i

• Strong written technical documentation skills

• The ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to both technicians and nontechnical stakeholders

• The judgment to recognize when something should remain with the support team rather than becoming an escalation

• The discipline to continue root-cause investigation after service has been restored

• The ability and willingness to teach other technicians

• Availability during Philippines hours aligned with US Eastern operations, through 18:30 ET at the latest





BONUS POINTS FOR



• Healthcare facility or regulated-industry IT experience

• HaloPSA experience

• Strong Azure experience

• Microsoft Intune experience

• Microsoft Entra ID experience

• Experience leading a major i
 in a live client environment

• Experience deploying or administering business networking platforms

• Existing Microsoft 365 certifications

• Existing UniFi certifications



CERTIFICATION WE FUND



• Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert - Required

• UniFi Full Stack Professional - Required



We pay for the required training, the first exam attempt, and the time required to take it. A resit following an unsuccessful attempt is self-funded.



What this role is not



• It is not second-line support - If you want a permanently full ticket queue and success measured primarily by ticket count, this role will feel strange. Your time is intentionally protected, so you can investigate problems properly, determine root cause, and eliminate recurring issues rather than simply moving from one ticket to another.

• It is not a management seat. You have no direct reports. Your influence comes from technical credibility, ownership, documentation, and teaching, not from managing a team.

• It is not a heroics seat. The measure is repeat i
 eliminated, not i
 attended. Being indispensable in a crisis is easy; making the crisis stop recurring is the job.

• It is not client-facing in the relationship sense. You will be on client calls during i
. The relationship stays with the PAM, and you hand it back when the i
 closes.



What you will get



• Protected time to think - Written into the model, defended by your manager, and the reason this seat exists at all.

• Fixes that stay fixed - A route from your root cause analysis into an automation engineer's sprint, so the problem you solved does not come back in a different client.

• Purpose you can commit to - Every recurring fault you eliminate contributes to eliminating repetitive IT tasks for 1 million healthcare workers by 2050.

• Only hard problems - The PAM gate means the trivial never reaches you. Everything on your desk is genuinely difficult.

• A visible route on - Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect and Central Services Manager are all reachable from here, and all written down.



About ElasticlT



We are building a world where healthcare workers never wait for technology. We specialize in healthcare IT for healthcare facilities, providing managed services, automation and HIPAA-compliant solutions so medical and care professionals can focus on their residents rather than their systems.



Our North Star is simple and audacious: by 2050 we will eliminate repetitive IT tasks for 1 million healthcare workers. Our purpose is to deliver the impossible under pressure, so that organizations transform their perception of what is possible.



OUR VALUES



SIMPLIFY THE OVERWHELMING: Cut through confusion with clarity and convert half-hour tasks into one-click wins

RESCUE WHEN OTHERS PANIC: Respond when others would panic and deliver the impossible under pressure

BUILD LASTING CAPABILITY: create tools that spread like wildfire and teams that work without micromanaging

PERSIST THROUGH CHAOS: Adapt when goalposts keep moving and turn disasters into relationships

ENABLE HUMAN PURPOSE: Remove barriers so the focus can be on patients, not systems

root cause work actually held. That is a strange thing to optimize for and it is exactly

what we are asking you to do."

title: Crypto BD Lead: $100 Per Qualified Call + Uncapped Partnership Revenue (Player-Coach)
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.



𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. Every additional personally booked appointment pays $100, and every rep-booked appointment pays you the $30 override, starting from the first. The 30-day trial milestones above set the ramp: 2+ held by Day 14, 2+/week pace by Day 30.



$100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked



𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲, 𝘁𝘄𝗼 𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀:



Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗹𝗼𝗼𝗸𝘀 𝗹𝗶𝗸𝗲 𝗼𝗻 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽:



- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call



𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘀



Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.



𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆



Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. IMPORTANT: Your subject line must start with BOND OPS .

2. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

3. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

4. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

5. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

6. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.

title: AI QA Specialist
description:
Location: Remote. You must live in Brazil, Colombia or the Philippines; applications from other countries are not considered | Type: Full-time | Department: Engineering



About Dry Ground AI



Dry Ground AI helps mid-market companies become AI native. We design, build and run custom software, AI agents and automation workflows that operate in production for real businesses, not demos. We are a fully remote team working with clients across the U.S.



The role



We are looking for an AI QA Specialist who knows how to test AI, not only traditional software. Our agents answer questions, call tools and take actions for clients, so their behavior has to be checked for accuracy, consistency, safety, speed and cost before and after every release.



Our delivery workflow, Kaiken, already runs automated tests, Playwright end-to-end checks and security scanning on every change. You will own the part those pipelines don’t cover yet: how our agents actually behave. You will also build and automate on the side, and fix bugs you find when the fix is clear.



What you will do



• Design test plans for AI agents, chatbots and multi-step workflows: tool use, memory and context, hand-offs, edge cases and failure paths

• Build and maintain evaluation sets and regression suites for agent responses, including reference answers, scoring rubrics and LLM-as-judge checks

• Test for hallucinations, prompt injection, data leaks and unsafe or off-brand responses

• Measure latency, response quality and cost, and run load and capacity tests before launches and client rollouts

• Add AI checks to our CI pipeline so regressions are caught automatically, using Playwright, API tests and evaluation tools

• Investigate failures through logs, traces and APIs, find the root cause, and fix straightforward bugs yourself or hand clear reproductions to engineers

• Build small internal tools and automations that speed up testing and delivery

• Report findings to engineers and engagement managers in clear, plain language



What we are looking for



• 3 or more years in QA or test engineering, with hands-on test automation

• Experience testing AI or LLM-powered products: chatbots, agents, RAG systems or generative features

• Understanding of how AI agents work and how they fail: tool calls, context limits, non-deterministic outputs

• Automation with Playwright, Cypress or similar, plus API testing

• Scripting in Python or TypeScript; comfortable reading and fixing code

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, promptfoo, DeepEval or Ragas

• Daily use of AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, with Git and GitHub

• Fluent written and spoken English



Nice to have



• Load and performance testing (k6, JMeter, Locust)

• CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions) and interest in growing toward DevOps or SRE

• Red-teaming or AI safety testing

• Building agents or automations yourself (LangGraph, n8n, MCP)

• Consulting or agency background with direct client delivery



What we offer

• Competitive compensation 

• Fully remote, flexible schedule

• High ownership: you set the quality bar for the AI systems we ship

• Real AI systems in production across multiple industries

• Training and development support



How to apply 



• Please submit your resume and portfolio with two or three relevant examples of your work. 

• Submit a 1 to 2 minute video and share how you would explain to a non-technical client why an AI chatbot can give different answers to the same question, and how you’d make sure it stays reliable.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer / Technical Owner - React, TypeScript, Supabase
description:
MIARI is a live SaaS platform for influencer marketing. We are hiring one hands-on senior full-stack developer to take long-term technical ownership of our website and application.



COMPENSATION AND HOURS

USD $600 per month, full-time, 40 hours per week. Please apply only if this budget works for you. We need 3-4 hours of daily overlap with Israel time (Asia/Jerusalem; UTC+2 or UTC+3 depending on daylight saving).



THE WORK

You will inherit an existing React/TypeScript application built with Lovable, managed through GitHub, with Supabase/PostgreSQL on the backend. It has technical debt and recurring production issues. The priority is to understand the system, stabilize critical flows, fix root causes, and make changes safely while supporting ongoing business requests.



We need a developer who can independently read, write, debug, review and explain code. Experience prompting AI tools alone is not sufficient. AI coding tools are welcome, but you must verify their output and personally own correctness, security and maintainability.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own frontend, backend, database, integrations and deployment troubleshooting end to end.

- Diagnose production bugs using reproducible cases, browser/network tools, logs and SQL; document root causes and prevent regressions.

- Refactor large React components and duplicated backend logic incrementally without breaking live customer workflows.

- Work confidently in GitHub: branches, focused pull requests, code review, merge conflicts, checks, releases and rollback.

- Maintain Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, Row Level Security (RLS), Edge Functions and webhooks.

- Understand Lovable-generated code and the Lovable/GitHub workflow; safely improve the code directly when necessary.

- Add meaningful tests for critical flows, including payments, contracts, permissions and integrations.

- Prioritize issues, communicate realistic estimates, flag blockers early, and send concise daily updates with completed work, evidence and next steps.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Strong hands-on React, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL and PostgreSQL skills in production systems.

- Practical Supabase experience, including authorization/RLS and safe database changes.

- Evidence of taking over an existing codebase, fixing difficult bugs and improving reliability.

- Strong Git/GitHub skills and ability to explain architectural decisions and trade-offs.

- Clear written English, dependable availability and independent execution.

- Familiarity with Lovable, or the ability to quickly understand its workflow while demonstrating strong underlying engineering skills.



HOW TO APPLY -
 ONLY

Send your application to 
 MIARI SENIOR - REFACTOR - Your Name

All screening and interview coordination will be by
. Do not contact us on WhatsApp.



Include your CV, GitHub/portfolio links, earliest start date, availability in Israel time, and answers to ALL questions below. Use specific examples from your own work. Do not disclose a previous employer's confidential code or credentials.



SCREENING QUESTIONS

1. Confirm that USD $600/month for 40 hours/week works for you. State your available hours and current work commitments.

2. Describe a production system you personally maintained: stack, your exact responsibilities, and one relevant code sample or pull request you are allowed to share. If private, provide a sanitized sample and explain it.

3. Describe a difficult production bug you solved: symptoms, investigation, root cause, code/database change, and how you verified the fix.

4. How would you safely split a 4,300-line React component while feature work continues? Explain testing, PR size and rollback.

5. A logged-in user can access another customer's records in Supabase. Where would you investigate, how would you contain the problem, and how would you test the authorization fix?

6. A payment webhook may be delivered twice or concurrently. How would you prevent duplicate processing at the database level and handle retries safely?

7. A Lovable change conflicts with work in GitHub. Explain how you would inspect, resolve, test and deploy the result without losing valid changes.

8. What would you inspect in your first week before making large changes? Explain how you prioritize i
, technical debt and feature requests.



SELECTION PROCESS

 application and technical questionnaire -> shortlisted candidates complete a paid technical exercise -> code review and live technical interview -> final decision.



The exercise is 3-5 hours, paid USD $50, as in our existing hiring process. It uses an isolated sample project with fictional data, never our live system. It focuses on React/TypeScript debugging, Supabase authorization, safe webhook processing, tests and a clear GitHub-style change explanation. We will agree the scope and timing by
 before you begin. You must disclose AI/tool assistance and be able to explain and modify your solution live.



We assess code quality, debugging depth, security, test evidence, system understanding and reliable communication. Our goal is to invite the two strongest candidates to interviews after reviewing their questionnaire and exercise. This is a long-term role for someone who takes real ownership of the system.

title: Head of Growth- Sales
description:
WE'RE HIRING: Head of Growth & Revenue



Senior E-Commerce & CPG Growth Strategist | Full-Time | Remote | Philippines or Latin America



About The Patch Method™



The Patch Method™ is a fast-growing, female-founded wearable wellness brand on a mission to make everyday wellness simpler, smarter, and more accessible through innovative vitamin patches. We're expanding across direct-to-consumer e-commerce, Amazon, retail, and strategic partnerships while launching products that bring a fresh perspective to the wellness industry. We're building a category-defining consumer brand, and we're looking for exceptional people who want to help build what comes next.



The Role



We're looking for a commercially minded, data-driven Head of Growth & Revenue to take ownership of sales growth across The Patch Method.



This is not a social media manager, a paid ads specialist, or someone who simply suggests marketing ideas. We need a growth leader who understands how successful CPG and DTC brands scale, can identify the greatest revenue opportunities, and knows how to turn strategy into measurable results through a team of specialists.



You will be responsible for developing and driving our company-wide revenue growth strategy across DTC, Amazon, wholesale, retail, affiliates, and new product launches.



You'll work directly with the Founder & CEO to define revenue goals, prioritize growth initiatives, coordinate marketing execution, and continuously improve customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and overall customer lifetime value.



You won't be expected to personally execute every ad campaign,
, or creative asset. You will be expected to know what needs to happen, why it matters, who should own it, and whether it is working.



Success in your first 90 days means:



A clear company-wide revenue dashboard and weekly growth reporting system are established.



A channel-by-channel revenue growth plan is developed, with priorities and measurable goals.



Customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and product performance have been analyzed to identify the biggest opportunities.



A 90-day growth roadmap is actively being executed across relevant sales channels.



Growth initiatives are being tested, measured, and optimized based on revenue, customer economics, and contribution margin.



Core Responsibilities



Own the company-wide sales growth strategy. Build and lead measurable revenue plans across Shopify DTC, Amazon, wholesale, retail, affiliate partnerships, and new product launches.



Lead customer acquisition strategy. Evaluate Meta, Google, TikTok, creator partnerships, affiliates, organic traffic, and other acquisition opportunities, identifying where investment can generate profitable growth.



Drive customer retention and lifetime value. Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases, subscription adoption, replenishment, customer loyalty, and revenue from existing customers.



Improve e-commerce conversion. Analyze Shopify conversion rates, landing pages, product pages, checkout performance, upsells, bundles, average order value, and customer experience.



Develop product and merchandising growth strategies. Use sales data, customer behavior, product performance, and market insights to recommend product positioning, bundles, promotional strategies, and revenue opportunities.



Lead product launch revenue planning. Build commercial launch strategies, forecasts, campaign plans, channel priorities, and performance measurement for new SKUs.



Coordinate growth specialists and partners. Direct the strategic priorities of paid media,
/SMS, creative, affiliate, and other marketing contributors without personally needing to execute every function.



Own growth analytics and forecasting. Establish dashboards and track total revenue, channel revenue, CAC, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, AOV, LTV, repeat purchase rate, and contribution margin.



Identify sales channel expansion opportunities. Evaluate growth potential across marketplaces, wholesale accounts, strategic partnerships, creator commerce, and emerging distribution channels, working with the founder on high-value opportunities.



Run weekly revenue reviews and experiments. Present performance against targets, diagnose gaps, recommend action, prioritize tests, and ensure learnings translate into improved execution.



Required Qualifications



6+ years in e-commerce, growth marketing, revenue strategy, or commercial growth roles, including meaningful ownership of growth outcomes.



Proven experience scaling a physical consumer product brand, ideally in CPG, wellness, beauty, supplements, or lifestyle.



Strong knowledge of Shopify and the DTC customer journey.



Demonstrated success increasing revenue while monitoring acquisition costs, profitability, and retention.



Solid working knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads, Klaviyo,
/SMS, affiliate marketing, and conversion rate optimization.



Ability to interpret marketing performance reports and build actionable growth strategies from data.



Experience planning and executing product launch strategies.



Experience leading or coordinating external specialists, agencies, or internal marketing teams.



Strong financial and analytical skills, including familiarity with gross margin, contribution margin, CAC, and customer lifetime value.



Excellent English communication skills and ability to confidently present strategic recommendations to the founder.



Experience building forecasts, performance dashboards, and structured growth roadmaps.



Non-negotiable: You must be able to provide concrete examples of sales growth you personally helped lead, including starting revenue, ending revenue, timeframe, major actions taken, and how profitability was considered.



Bonus Qualifications



Experience growing consumer brands from approximately $1M to $5M+ in annual revenue.



Experience with Amazon marketplace growth, wholesale, and omnichannel CPG strategies.



Experience scaling subscription or replenishment-based products.



Familiarity with Shopify analytics, GA4, Klaviyo, TikTok Shop, Faire, and attribution/reporting tools.



Experience with Amazon, specialty retail, or creator-driven commerce.



Understanding of inventory planning, product launch economics, and the impact of promotions on margins.



Experience using AI tools for growth research, analytics, experimentation, or workflow efficiency.



What Dedicated Means



This is a full-time, long-term, exclusive position working 40 hours per week for The Patch Method. We are not hiring a freelance consultant, fractional growth advisor, or agency strategist. You will be an embedded member of our leadership team, exclusively focused on growing our brand. We require 4–5 working hours of daily overlap with Arizona Mountain Standard Time (UTC−7 year-round), with flexibility for remaining working hours. You must be available for weekly revenue meetings, cross-functional planning, and regular collaboration with the founder.

Payment

title: Content & Social Media Manager (Remote)
description:
Beautygirl & Co | Brow & Lash Studio / brow educator | Sydney, Australia



Pay: $6-9usd per hour, depending on experience

Hours: 20-30 hours per week to start, growing to 30 once output and quality are consistently met

Type: Contract, ongoing, remote

Availability: Responding between [9am–5pm] Sydney time (AEDT), Monday to Friday

Start date: asap

Who this suits



Someone organised, self-directed, creative and genuinely good with people.



You know how to plan, edit and market content in any niche. You think like a marketer, not just an editor. You don’t only make what you’re given. You know why it works and what to make next.



If you need to be chased for updates or told what to make every day, this isn’t the role for you.



About us

-We’re a brow and lash studio in Penrith, Sydney.

-We specialise in brow dye, lamination, waxing, shaping, cosmetic tattooing and Korean lash lifting.

-Alongside clients, we run in-person and online training for beauty therapists learning brow dye, wax and lamination, plus the business and marketing side most courses leave out.

-It’s a one-woman operation.



The role

- You’ll keep our online presence alive, our content moving and our inbox handled while I’m behind the chair.

- This isn’t a “post and ghost” job, and it isn’t a “wait to be told” job. I need someone who brings ideas, knows what’s trending, and understands that content exists to sell, not just to fill a feed.



What you’ll be doing

-Content strategy & planning

-Building the monthly content calendar, due by the [20th] of each month

- Researching trending reels, sounds and formats every week

- Pitching 5 reel ideas per week, each with a hook, format and audience

- Pitching 2–3 marketing ideas per week, plus 1 bigger campaign idea per month

- Planning content for our two audiences:

- Clients: local women who want low-maintenance, reliable brows and lashes

- Students: beauty therapists wanting to learn the skills and build a profitable business



Content creation

- Editing reels from raw clips, following our style guide and example videos

- Adding captions to reels

- Writing 3–5 reel and talking-head scripts per week, each with a hook, key points and a call to action

- Building 1–6 carousels per week in Canva from our templates

- Repurposing existing content into carousel captions or stories

- Transcribing videos and reels



Engagement & outreach (1 hour per day)

- Reaching out to 20–30 potential students and beauty creators daily

- Leaving 10–15 genuine comments on other accounts daily

- Sending outreach DMs using our scripts

- Replying to comments with real engagement, not one-word replies

- Editing and posting stories daily, then replying to engagement



 marketing - bonus if you know it room for extra hours per week - using flodesk



Admin

- Pulling and formatting 2–3 testimonials or reviews per week for stories for each page, I have a salon page and page used for educating and targeting students

Keeping the shared Canva and Google Drive folders tidy and up to date



Workload expectations

-Everything comes with templates, style guides, scripts and raw footage, so the work is set up to move fast.

-Reels: approx. 30 minutes per reel, building to 6 reels per day at full hours

-Carousels: 2–3 per hour from templates, 1–6 per week

-Scripts: 2–3 per hour

-Engagement: 1 hour per day

-Content calendar: delivered by the [20th] each month



These are minimums, not stretch goals. A full daily and weekly schedule will be provided once you start.

If something’s taking longer than expected, tell me early. A problem I hear about on Monday is easy to fix. One I find out about on Friday isn’t.



How we track work

All hours are logged in on your preferred platfrom, work created sent back or logged daily and market off daily tasks

An end-of-shift update goes into Notion or WhatsApp: what’s done, what’s in progress, and links to finished work

Weekly Friday check-in via voice note

Output is reviewed against tracked hours every week



Trial period: The first 4 weeks are a trial, with a review at the end.



What you need (non-negotiable)

- Content planning. You can build a monthly calendar from scratch with clear pillars, a mix of formats, and a purpose behind every post.

- Creative direction. You come up with original ideas, spot trends early, and adapt them to any brand’s voice.

- Editing. A paid CapCut Pro account and strong skills: hooks, pacing, cutting to sound, transitions, text animation, captions, colour correction and keyframes.

- Marketing & selling online. You understand how content moves people from viewer → follower → enquiry → paying customer (training will also be given for direction on ways we need marketing done as well)

- A portfolio of content you’ve created for a brand

- A typing speed of 40–60 WPM minimum (screenshot of a typing test required)

- Strong written English with a warm, natural tone

- Confidence in Canva, Instagram,
, Google Drive, and Google Docs or Notion



Confidentiality

- All content, scripts, templates, course material and client information remain the property of Beautygirl & Co and must be kept confidential.



How to apply - paid trial to serious applicants 

- Use points to apply, leave your portfolio link in application, 

- A short intro about you

- Links to your portfolio or accounts you’ve managed

- Your typing test screenshot

- 3 reel ideas for Beautygirl & Co, with a hook for each:

- One for clients

- One for students

- One based on a trend you’ve seen this month



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid, timed trial task: editing 2 reels and 1 carousel from our templates.

title: Appointment Setter and Outbound Caller
description:
We’re looking for an Outbound Sales Development Representative with a strong focus on outbound calling and appointment setting to build pipeline for a fast-moving B2B sales intelligence platform. You’ll call and prospect into SMB and mid-market accounts, use
 and LinkedIn to support your outreach, qualify prospects, and book well-prepared meetings for the sales team.



This is a phone-forward, high-activity role. You’ll follow a clear outbound playbook, make consistent calls, handle objections, and guide promising conversations toward a scheduled meeting. You’ll also use AI tools daily to research accounts and personalize outreach so you can work efficiently without sacrificing quality.



If you’re a confident communicator with strong English skills, enjoy outbound calling, and have a track record of setting qualified appointments, this role could be a strong fit.



Why You’ll Want to Join

	• You’ll be paid in USD, bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th.

	• Paid time off is provided in accordance with company policy.

	• Holidays are observed per company guidelines.

	• Enjoy a 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you’re most productive.

	• This is a full-time role structured as three weekdays plus two weekend days. Weekend availability is a core requirement.

	• Weekend shifts rotate across Opener, Mid, and Closer shifts to provide 24-hour coverage. Exact schedules are confirmed before your start date.

	• Work at the front end of the pipeline for a B2B platform with strong case studies and real customer traction.

	• Take ownership of outbound activity and appointment setting that directly supports revenue and growth.



What You’ll Work On



Outbound Calling and Appointment Setting

	• Make consistent, high-volume outbound calls to prospects at target SMB and mid-market accounts.

	• Open conversations confidently, identify prospect needs, and communicate the value of the platform.

	• Handle objections professionally and keep conversations moving toward a qualified, booked meeting.

	• Schedule appointments for the sales team and confirm meeting details with prospects.

	• Use
 and LinkedIn to support call outreach, follow up with prospects, and improve meeting conversion.

	• Keep prospects engaged through the handoff to the sales team.



Prospect Research and Qualification

	• Research accounts and prospects using the platform’s sales intelligence tools and AI-assisted research.

	• Qualify prospects against defined ideal customer profile (ICP) criteria before booking meetings.

	• Capture relevant discovery details and qualification notes so the sales team is prepared.

	• Maintain accurate records of calls, follow-ups, and pipeline activity in the CRM.



AI-Enabled Outreach

	• Use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT daily to research accounts, prepare for calls, draft personalized follow-ups, and improve efficiency.

	• Test and refine call approaches and messaging based on response data and feedback from the sales team.

	• Stay current on AI tools that can improve prospecting speed and quality.



Pipeline Tracking and Handoff

	• Track call volume, connection rates, response rates, and meeting conversion metrics consistently.

	• Coordinate scheduling and follow-up to reduce missed meetings and keep prospects engaged.

	• Provide clean, accurate handoffs with context and qualification notes for every booked meeting.



What You Bring

	• Prior SDR, outbound sales, appointment setting, or lead generation experience, with a track record of booking meetings.

	• Strong spoken and written English communication skills. This is essential for a phone- and
-focused role.

	• A confident, professional phone presence and the ability to handle objections and rejection while maintaining momentum.

	• Comfort using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT daily for research, call preparation, drafting, and outreach personalization.

	• Experience using CRM platforms to log activity and manage a pipeline.

	• A self-directed, disciplined approach and the ability to meet daily activity targets independently.

	• Availability to work three weekdays plus both Saturday and Sunday on a rotational shift basis. This is a firm requirement.



Nice to Have

	• Experience selling to SMBs in industries such as HVAC, dental, restaurants, or similar markets.

	• Familiarity with sales intelligence or data enrichment platforms.

	• Experience with sales engagement platforms such as Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar tools.

	• A background in B2B SaaS or go-to-market roles.



How to Apply



Please include:

	1. Your updated resume.

	2. A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your outbound calling and appointment setting experience, and showing how you use AI tools to research a prospect and personalize your outreach before a call.



Only candidates who submit a Loom video will move to the next step of the hiring process.

If you’re a confident communicator who enjoys outbound calling, knows how to turn prospect conversations into qualified appointments, uses AI to work efficiently, and can work weekends as part of your regular schedule, this role offers clear expectations and a direct impact on the sales pipeline.

title: Cold Caller
description:
We're looking for a **Cold Caller** to own outbound phone-based outreach for a newly founded private equity firm actively sourcing acquisition targets across IT managed services, marketing agencies, BPO, accounting and finance, logistics, SaaS, software development, and recruiting. You will make a high volume of outbound calls to business owners and company leaders to identify potential acquisition interest, qualify conversations, and book meetings for the deal team.



This is a pure cold calling role. You will be dialing business owners and operators all day, opening conversations from cold, and moving qualified interest forward to the next step. The work is repetitive, the rejection rate is high, and results come from consistent volume and a professional, confident phone manner. If you are resilient, disciplined, and motivated by a clear and measurable output, this role is a strong fit.



## Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy

- Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines

- **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive

- This role requires availability during **US business hours**

- Work at the front end of the deal pipeline for a newly founded private equity firm with an active acquisitions thesis

- High-activity role with clear metrics and direct impact on deal flow



## What You'll Work On



**High-Volume Outbound Cold Calling**



- Make high-volume outbound calls to business owners and company leaders across target verticals daily

- Open cold conversations professionally and pivot quickly to qualify acquisition interest

- Handle objections confidently and keep conversations moving toward a booked meeting or callback

- Maintain a consistent, high call volume throughout the full working day without losing energy or quality



**Lead Qualification and Pipeline Management**



- Qualify prospects based on defined criteria including business type, revenue range, ownership structure, and interest level

- Log all call activity, outcomes, and notes accurately in the CRM after every interaction

- Book qualified meetings for the deal team with full context and qualification notes

- Follow up on warm contacts and callbacks consistently



**Reporting and Communication**



- Meet daily and weekly call volume targets consistently

- Report on call activity, connect rates, and meetings booked regularly

- Flag patterns in objections or prospect feedback that could improve targeting or messaging



## What You Bring



- Prior cold calling experience with a track record of booking meetings or qualified conversations from cold outreach

- Confident, clear, and professional phone presence with the ability to engage a business owner or executive from a cold call

- Comfortable with high rejection rates and able to reset quickly between calls without losing momentum

- Fluent, professional spoken English; this is a phone-first role and your voice is the product

- Organized with clean CRM habits and accurate call logging

- Reliable, self-directed, and disciplined with the ability to hit daily activity targets independently

- Quiet, professional calling environment and reliable high-speed internet



## Nice to Have



- Experience cold calling in a B2B context including business owners, executives, or operators

- Background in deal sourcing, business development, or financial services outreach

- Familiarity with the verticals being targeted including IT services, marketing agencies, BPO, accounting, logistics, SaaS, or recruiting



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your **updated resume**

2. A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your cold calling experience, and giving an example of how you handle a business owner who immediately says they are not interested in selling



**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**



If you are resilient, disciplined, and comfortable making a high volume of cold calls to business owners every day, this role gives you the volume, the mission, and the direct impact to do your best work.

title: Video Editor (Long Term Position)
description:
Video Editor – YouTube, Reels & Short-Form Content (Long-Term Position)



Company: Peakfinity Labs  

Website: 
  

Position: Video Editor  

Job Type: Full-Time / Long-Term  

Location: Remote



About Us



Peakfinity Labs is a supplement and cosmetic contract manufacturing company helping eCommerce entrepreneurs build, launch, and scale their own brands.



We work with Shopify brands, Amazon sellers, TikTok Shop entrepreneurs, and established businesses to develop and manufacture high-quality products.



We're building a strong presence across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and X by producing educational, engaging content about eCommerce, entrepreneurship, supplement manufacturing, and building successful consumer brands.



This isn't a position where you'll simply cut clips and add subtitles. We want someone who understands storytelling, pacing, viewer psychology, and how to keep an audience engaged.



What You'll Be Doing



- Editing short-form and long form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and X.

- Editing longer educational YouTube videos, interviews, and company content.

- Turning raw talking-head footage into engaging, professionally edited videos.

- Creating attention-grabbing hooks within the first few seconds.

- Adding clean, modern captions, motion graphics, B-roll, animations, and sound effects where appropriate.

- Incorporating footage from our manufacturing facilities, laboratories, production lines, and warehouses.

- Finding relevant B-roll, screenshots, graphics, and visual examples to support what's being discussed.

- Removing unnecessary pauses, filler words, and sections that hurt pacing.

- Repurposing long-form videos into multiple short-form clips.

- Maintaining consistent branding, typography, and editing styles.

- Organizing project files and managing multiple video projects.

- Working with our team to continuously improve editing quality and audience retention.



What We're Looking For



Required Skills:



- Strong experience editing short-form social media content.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software.

- Ability to create motion graphics using After Effects or equivalent tools.

- Excellent understanding of pacing, storytelling, and audience retention.

- Experience editing talking-head videos, educational content, or business-related videos.

- Ability to use B-roll, visual storytelling, and graphics to make complex subjects easy to understand.

- Strong attention to detail, particularly with audio, captions, and transitions.

- Ability to follow creative direction while also contributing your own ideas.

- Good English comprehension and communication skills.

- Reliable internet connection and ability to meet deadlines consistently.



Bonus Skills:



- Experience editing YouTube videos for business or educational creators.

- Experience with direct-response advertising or eCommerce brands.

- Understanding of YouTube analytics, retention graphs, and content performance.

- Experience with AI-powered editing tools.

- Ability to create professional thumbnails.

- Experience with color grading and audio enhancement.

- Familiarity with content from business creators such as Alex Hormozi or similar educational channels.



Our Editing Style



We're looking for clean, modern, professional editing that prioritizes viewer engagement. We will provide examples.



Our content includes:



- Educational videos explaining how supplement manufacturing works.

- Behind-the-scenes footage of real manufacturing facilities.

- Business and eCommerce advice for entrepreneurs.

- Founder-led talking-head videos.

- Industry breakdowns and comparisons.

- Interviews, discussions, and longer YouTube videos.



We want videos that feel polished and credible while still being entertaining.



We do NOT want excessive transitions, unnecessary animations, or distracting effects every two seconds.



Every edit should have a purpose.



The goal is to make complicated subjects interesting, keep viewers watching, and establish Peakfinity Labs as a trusted authority in the manufacturing industry.



What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?



We're looking for an editor who thinks beyond simply completing an assigned video.



A great candidate will:



- Recognize when a section of footage is boring and know how to improve it.

- Understand how the first 3 seconds influence short-form video performance.

- Know when to use B-roll, graphics, or a simple clean cut.

- Be comfortable suggesting improvements to pacing and structure.

- Understand the difference between editing for TikTok and editing for YouTube.

- Take ownership of their work without needing constant supervision.

- Be interested in improving their skills and growing alongside our company.



What We Offer



- Long-term, consistent work with a growing company.

- Opportunity to work on a variety of interesting video projects.

- Creative freedom to contribute ideas and improve our content.

- Clear direction, organized workflows, and constructive feedback.

- Opportunities for increased responsibility as our content operation expands.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and skill level.



We're looking to build a long-term relationship with the right person, not hire someone for a handful of videos.



How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Your portfolio: Send a link to your previous video editing work. YouTube, Google Drive, Vimeo, or a personal portfolio website are all acceptable.

2. Relevant experience: Briefly describe your experience editing short-form videos, YouTube content, or educational/business videos.

3. Software:Which editing programs do you primarily use?

4. Availability: Are you available for full-time work? How many hours per week can you commit?

5. Your strongest work: Which 2–3 existing videos in your portfolio best demonstrate your editing abilities, and why?



Important: We're particularly interested in editors who have experience making educational or talking-head content engaging. Please prioritize relevant examples in your portfolio.



We're excited to find someone who wants to grow with Peakfinity Labs and help us build a high-quality content operation.

title: Experienced Cleaning Services Sales & Booking Agent
description:
Previous experience in the cleaning services industry, specifically in sales, quotations, and bookings, is MANDATORY.



Are you the kind of sales professional who can turn a “How much would it cost to clean my property?” enquiry into a confirmed booking?



Have you previously worked in sales and bookings for a professional cleaning company, handling domestic cleaning, end-of-tenancy cleaning, deep cleaning, office cleaning, or other residential and commercial cleaning services?



If you know how to quote cleaning jobs, handle price objections, negotiate with customers, and close bookings confidently, we want to hear from you!



We are a UK-based professional cleaning services company serving customers across London, hiring experienced full-time remote Cleaning Services Sales & Booking Agents based in the Philippines.



Your main priority is simple: convert inbound enquiries into confirmed cleaning bookings quickly, accurately, and professionally.



MANDATORY REQUIREMENT: Previous Cleaning Services Industry Experience



We are only considering candidates who have previous hands-on sales, quotation, and booking experience within the professional cleaning services industry, including services such as residential and commercial professional cleaning services and all related services.



Experience in the cleaning industry from any country is welcome. Previous UK market experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.



You must understand how cleaning enquiries are handled, how to gather the information required to prepare accurate quotations, and how to convert customer enquiries into confirmed cleaning appointments.



General call centre, customer support, or sales experience alone is NOT sufficient without relevant cleaning industry experience.



We are specifically looking for candidates who have worked directly with customers in a cleaning company, rather than applicants whose experience is limited to performing cleaning work.



What Success Looks Like



You confidently turn inbound calls,
s, and messages into confirmed cleaning bookings.

You understand different cleaning services and can recommend the most suitable option based on the customer's needs.



You know how to qualify cleaning enquiries and provide accurate, competitive quotations.



You effectively handle price objections, customer hesitation, and competitor comparisons.



You can negotiate professionally and work within company pricing guidelines to secure bookings.



You follow up on warm leads, pending quotations, and unconfirmed appointments to maximise conversions.



You consistently meet booking targets and contribute to the company's sales performance.



You can identify opportunities for additional services, upgrades, and recurring cleaning bookings.



Your Day-to-Day Responsibilities



Answer inbound calls,
s, messages, and customer enquiries about our cleaning services.



Identify customer requirements and recommend appropriate cleaning solutions.



Gather essential information, including property location and postcode, property type and size, number of bedrooms and bathrooms, cleaning condition, access arrangements, preferred date, and any special requirements.



Prepare accurate quotations using our pricing structure and internal guidelines.



Convert enquiries into confirmed domestic and commercial cleaning bookings.



Handle objections, discuss pricing, and negotiate confidently within company guidelines.



Explain service inclusions, exclusions, available cleaning options, and booking procedures clearly.



Follow up on missed calls, open quotations, and potential bookings.



Coordinate cleaning appointments according to team availability and scheduling requirements.



Maintain accurate customer records, booking details, and follow-up notes in our internal system.



Identify opportunities to upsell additional services and secure repeat business.



What We're Looking For



Mandatory: Previous sales and booking experience with a professional cleaning services company.

Minimum 2–3 years of call centre or phone-based customer sales experience.

Proven ability to close sales and convert customer enquiries into confirmed bookings.

Familiarity with cleaning service quotations, pricing structures, property requirements, and booking procedures.

Good understanding of domestic, end-of-tenancy, deep cleaning, and commercial cleaning services.

Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, confident, and professional telephone manner.

Strong sales, objection-handling, negotiation, and follow-up skills.

Ability to build customer trust and explain the value of professional cleaning services.

Results-driven attitude with a strong focus on conversion rates, sales targets, and confirmed bookings.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when preparing quotations and entering booking information.

Reliable attendance, punctuality, and consistent performance.

Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Stable internet connection, a reliable computer, and a suitable home working environment.



Working Hours & Location



Full-time, remote position based in the Philippines.

Working hours are aligned with UK business hours, meaning afternoon/evening or night shifts in the Philippines, depending on the schedule and seasonal UK time changes.







Training will be provided on our specific cleaning services, pricing structure, quotation guidelines, booking systems, customer communication standards, and internal procedures.



Please note: This training is designed for candidates who already understand the professional cleaning services industry.



It is not intended as introductory training for applicants without relevant cleaning sales and booking experience.



We expect candidates to bring practical industry knowledge, strong sales skills, and the confidence to handle customer enquiries and convert them into bookings.



How to Apply

Important: Start your application with the word "CLEANING".



Please send:

Your updated CV/resume.

A short introduction (1–2 paragraphs) explaining your previous experience in cleaning services sales and bookings. Specify the cleaning companies you worked for, the services you handled, and your responsibilities in preparing quotations and closing bookings.



Details of your sales performance, such as average monthly bookings, conversion rates, or sales targets achieved, if available.



A link to a short English voice recording or introduction video demonstrating your communication skills and professional telephone manner.



Applications without relevant previous cleaning services sales and booking experience will not be considered.



We are looking for experienced, results-driven booking closers who understand the cleaning industry, know how to sell professional cleaning services, and can start converting enquiries into confirmed jobs.



If you have the right experience and a proven ability to turn enquiries into bookings, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Appointment Setter — US Real Estate Investing (Phone Sales, EST Hours)
description:
TYPE: Full-time · SALARY: $600–$2,000/month (base + performance) · HOURS: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST, Mon–Fri (1 hr break)



READ THIS FIRST



This is a phone job. You will be on calls with American real estate investors for most of your shift. If you are looking for admin, data entry, or general VA work, this is not it.



We are a US company that helps investors buy cash-flowing apartment buildings. We do the sourcing, the analysis, and the negotiation. Our clients invest $40,000 or more.



Your job is to get the right people onto our calendar and make sure they show up.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



Two power blocks each day calling leads already in our CRM — people who opted in, requested information, or spoke with us before. This is not cold calling strangers. They know who we are.



Golden hours taking inbound calls from new leads who just requested information.



Qualifying every prospect against a hard gate: available capital, credit, decision-maker, timeline.



Booking qualified prospects into a Deep Dive call with our Executive Consultant.



A 2-minute check-in call after every booking to confirm they watched the pre-call video and will attend.



Logging every call in our CRM the same day. No exceptions.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Phone sales experience is required. Appointment setting, inside sales, BPO outbound, or similar. Tell us exactly what you sold, to whom, and your numbers.

American-sounding English. Clear, natural, confident. US clients must be comfortable with you in the first ten seconds.

You can hold a frame. Our prospects are often successful, direct, and sometimes dominant. Some will push back hard or dodge the capital question. You need to ask again, politely and without flinching, until you get a real answer. If you tend to agree with people to keep things pleasant, you will not enjoy this role.

You are reliable. You show up when scheduled, you hit your call numbers every day without being reminded, and you complete your forms. This matters more to us than talent.

Real estate background is a plus, not required.

Stable internet, a quiet workspace, a working headset, and a backup power plan.



COMPENSATION



Training (first 2 weeks): $4.00/hour.



After training:



Base: $250 per pay period (semi-monthly)

Bonus per qualified Deep Dive that is held

Percentage of program sales from appointments you set

Guaranteed minimum $1,000/month for your first 60 days while you ramp

Realistic earnings once producing: $1,200–$2,000/month



Top performers earn the top of that range. We pay for results, and we pay on time.



TRAINING AND SUPPORT



Two weeks of direct 1-on-1 training with the CEO, 2–4 hours per day, plus self-study and recorded call review. You get the script, the objection framework, and recordings of real calls.



After training: two meetings per week. We are not going to micromanage you. We will give you clear targets and expect you to hit them. If you have a better idea about how we do something, we want to hear it — that is how our operations lead works and it works well.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW ALL THREE STEPS



Applications missing any step will not be reviewed. This is intentional.



1. Start your message with the word BLUEPRINT so we know you read this.



2. Answer these in writing:



What have you sold on the phone, to whom, and what were your numbers?

Describe one call where the prospect pushed back hard and you did not back down. What did you say?

Why did you leave your last phone role?



3. Record a 2-minute voice sample (any recorder, send a link):



First minute: introduce yourself as if calling a US investor who filled out our form.

Second minute: the prospect says “I’d rather not share how much capital I have.” Respond as you would on a live call. Do not script it perfectly — we want to hear how you actually sound.



We review within 3 business days. Shortlisted candidates do one live role-play with the CEO.

title: Senior US Tax Accountant
description:
An Accounting Firm based in Chicago, USA seeking a highly experienced US Tax & Accounting professional with strong technical expertise in individual and business taxation. The ideal candidate should understand how accurate bookkeeping serves as the foundation for tax compliance, tax planning, and advisory services.



The role requires hands-on technical capabilities, independent problem-solving, and the ability to manage complex tax and accounting matters.



Key Responsibilities



1. Tax Preparation & Review



Prepare and review federal and state individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1065, 1120S, and 1120.

Handle tax returns at either the preparer or reviewer level, depending on the complexity of the return and the candidate's technical competency.

Identify tax issues, reporting inconsistencies, and opportunities for tax optimization.



2. Tax Planning & Advisory



Prepare individual and business tax projections and tax plans.

Analyze tax implications of business transactions and financial decisions.

Provide practical, tax-efficient recommendations based on applicable federal and state tax laws.

3. Tax Notices & Issue Resolution



Research and resolve IRS and state tax notices.

Identify compliance issues, determine corrective actions, and coordinate necessary responses.

Handle tax amendments and other tax-related resolutions.

4. Client Communication & Advisory



Communicate directly with clients regarding tax returns, outstanding requirements, tax liabilities, and planning recommendations.

Explain complex tax matters in a clear and practical manner.

Address client questions and provide technical guidance.

5. Bookkeeping & Tax Alignment



Serve as a technical consultant to the bookkeeping team to ensure financial records are properly aligned with tax reporting requirements.

Review tax-sensitive accounting transactions, classifications, and year-end adjustments.

Identify and resolve discrepancies between financial statements and tax returns.



6. Tax & Regulatory Compliance



Handle other federal, state, and local tax compliance requirements.

Research applicable tax laws and regulatory changes.

Ensure timely and accurate compliance filings.



7. New Client Onboarding & Accounting Projects



Lead accounting-related onboarding projects, including bookkeeping cleanup, catch-up, and historical reconciliations.

Evaluate existing books, identify accounting deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions.

Establish tax-ready accounting records and appropriate financial reporting structures.



Candidate Profile



Strong technical competency in US individual and business taxation.

Solid understanding of US accounting principles and their relationship to tax reporting.

Proven ability to independently research and resolve complex tax issues.

Experience preparing tax plans and providing client advisory.

Hands-on experience in bookkeeping cleanup, financial reporting, and accounting reconciliations.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and client communication skills.

title: Meta Ads Manager
description:
ABOUT US 

We're a Singapore-registered performance marketing agency running paid ads for 30+ clients worldwide. We're AI-native. Automation and AI tools handle the reporting, the checks and the busywork, so our ads managers spend their time on what actually moves results: testing, strategy and scaling.



THE ROLE 

You run Meta campaigns for your own client accounts, end to end. A normal week looks like this:



- Launch new campaigns: structure, audiences, budgets

- Test creatives, angles and audiences, and make the kill and scale calls

- Optimise daily against each client's targets: CPL, CPA, ROAS

- Keep accounts healthy: spend limits, tracking, ad policy

- Update clients on results in short, clear messages

- Work with our creative and automation team on what to test next



This is a specialist seat. Not a VA. Not an assistant. If you need step-by-step instructions to run a Meta campaign, this isn't for you.



WHAT YOU NEED



- 2+ years running Meta direct-response campaigns yourself, not under someone else's direction

- You've dealt with ad rejections and account restrictions and kept performance going

- Google Ads or TikTok Ads experience is a plus

- Clear written English for client messages

- Consistency. You show up every day at the same standard, whether or not anyone is watching.



HOW WE WORK



- You own your accounts. The results, the spend and the client relationship are yours.

- Reliability beats brilliance. Every working day, every meeting, the same standard.

- No surprises. Spend never runs past what a client has funded, and nothing is promised to a client that hasn't been agreed.

- Every account is safe before you sign off for the weekend.



WHAT YOU GET



- $600–1,200/month to start, based on experience, paid in USD

- A pay ladder. Your pay grows with the number of accounts you run and your time with us.

- A monthly Ads Manager of the Month award

- Flexible hours. Work whenever you like, Monday to Friday, as long as at least 4 of your hours fall inside 5:30 PM – 1:30 AM Philippine time. No weekend shifts.

- Fully remote

- AI and automation tools that take the manual grind off your plate

- International clients, and a Singapore company behind you

title: Senior KYC/KYB Analyst
description:
About Us
