Our team thrives on mutual respect, accountability, and continuous improvement, and we’re looking for someone who shares these values.



About You

We are looking for a highly accurate, detail-oriented, and analytical KYC/KYB Analyst to join our Compliance team. You will be responsible for conducting KYC and KYB checks, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting our onboarding and verification processes. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, works with integrity, and is comfortable handling sensitive information.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Own end-to-end KYC and KYB reviews for individual and corporate customers, from onboarding through approval, rejection or escalation.

Review and verify identity documents, proof of address, company registration documents, and complex ownership and control structures, identifying all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and controllers.

Carry out Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on high-risk customers, including PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, complex or opaque structures, crypto/Web3 businesses and unusual activity profiles.

Assess and evidence source of funds and source of wealth, and challenge customers where the explanation or documents are inconsistent or insufficient.

Perform AML screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media), resolve potential matches and document a clear rationale for each decision.

Complete customer risk assessments, assign risk ratings and recommend approval, conditional approval or rejection for complex and high-risk cases.

Escalate suspicious activity and red flags to the Head of Compliance, with well-documented case summaries to support any internal suspicious activity report.

Run periodic reviews and re-verification based on customer risk level, including trigger-based reviews when ownership, activity or risk profile changes.

Manage verification workflows in Sumsub (or similar KYC/AML tools), including configuring checks, resolving system issues and flagging improvements.

Respond to requests for information (RFIs) from banking and payment partners, preparing clear, complete case files within agreed timelines

Work with Support, Business, Product and Tech teams across multiple business units to resolve discrepancies, chase outstanding information and unblock stuck cases.

Contribute to improving KYC/KYB procedures, checklists and risk-assessment frameworks in line with regulatory requirements and partner expectations.

Keep accurate, audit-ready records for every check and decision.

Handle confidential and sensitive customer data with discretion, in line with data protection requirements.



REQUIREMENTS:

1–3 years of proven, hands-on experience in KYC and KYB verification, with a strong focus on reviewing and validating KYB documentation

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to efficiently identify inconsistencies, risks, and missing information

Proven experience following and adhering to internal SOPs, regulatory requirements, and compliance guidelines

Hands-on experience using Sumsub or similar AML/KYC tools (e.g., Veriff, Onfido, Persona, ComplyAdvantage)

Solid understanding of AML, KYC, and compliance processes, particularly in a B2B context

Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal

Comfortable working independently and managing time effectively

Availability: Must be available and responsive during the agreed 8-hour shift

Good Internet Connection: Reliable and stable for remote work

title: Operations Manager / Executive VA – US Trucking & Delivery
description:
Vincent Miller Trucking is a US-based delivery and logistics company. We contract

independent cargo van drivers who run dedicated Walmart retail delivery routes across

multiple states through our contracts with Curri and JW Logistics. During our peak

season we run 45 vans across 26 route locations, and we are growing.

We are looking for one exceptional person to run the day-to-day operations of the company –

not just assist with it. You will work directly with the owner and act as his right hand: recruiting

drivers, managing routes and schedules, handling communication, and keeping records clean.

When the owner is off, you run the show. This is a long-term position with room to grow as the

company grows. What You Will Do

Everything the owner does in his business day – you take it over and own it.

• Driver recruiting and hiring (the most important part of the job): post and rotate job

ads on Indeed, CB Drivers, and
 job groups; text and call applicants the

same day; screen them; walk them through onboarding until they are fully ready to

drive.

• Route coverage: make sure every route always has a driver. Track all routes in a coverage

tracker, confirm hired drivers are active, arrange backup drivers, and escalate immediately

if a route risks going uncovered.

• Scheduling: build and maintain weekly route schedules, manage 7-day assignments and

split schedules, and keep backup driver information current.

• Communication: answer driver calls,
s, and texts daily using our FAQ sheets; give

clear answers; take messages for the owner when needed and make sure every message

gets a callback the same day.

• Onboarding and payroll support: collect driver documents (van photo, license, insurance),

keep every driver's digital folder organized, send onboarding packets (agreement, W-9,

direct deposit), and set drivers up in Paychex Flex.

• Record keeping: maintain the master Excel tracker (routes, drivers, VINs, licenses,

documents) and prepare a simple weekly report for the owner (vans filled vs. open, hires

made, ads posted).

• Stakeholder communication: keep drivers and contract partners (Curri, JW Logistics

coordinators) informed throughout the season with short, professional updates.

• Social media support: post hiring ads and short promotional videos in local

groups for open route cities.

• Anything else the owner needs to hand off, learned quickly and executed 

Who You Are

Vincent Miller Trucking Job Post – Operations Manager (Remote)

• Excellent spoken and written English – you will be on the phone with American

drivers every day, and they must understand you easily and find you pleasant to

talk to.

• Fast learner: we will train you on our systems in week one, and we expect you to run with

it after that.

• Extremely organized – trackers, folders, and checklists are your natural habitat. Nothing

falls through the cracks.

• Proactive: you spot a route without coverage or an applicant waiting and act before being

asked.

• Reliable and available: consistent daily schedule, US business hours, responsive during

working hours.

• Comfortable with: Excel/Google Sheets, Gmail/Outlook, Paychex or willingness to learn it

fast, Indeed,
 groups, and smartphone apps (Curri/Nash).

• Experience in recruiting, dispatch, logistics, transportation, or executive assistance is a

strong plus.



The Offer

• Full-time, long-term position working directly with the owner.

• Work from home – all you need is a quiet space, reliable internet, and a headset.

• US business hours,  8am—10pm

• Salary: $850 /month, paid bi weekly , based on experience – we pay well for

someone who can truly run operations.

• Growth opportunity: as the company adds routes and vans, your role and pay grow with it.



How to Apply

Send us a message with:

• A short voice recording (30-60 seconds) telling us about yourself and your experience –

we hire for clear, friendly English first.

• Your resume or work history.

• Answer these three questions:

• (1) Have you done recruiting, dispatching, or driver coordination before? Tell us about it.

• (2) Describe a time you had to keep many moving pieces organized in one day – what did

you do?

• (3) What is your internet speed and what hours can you work US Eastern Time?

title: Experienced Sales Representative (Remote)
description:
Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter



Remote | Philippines



North London Massage Therapy is looking for an experienced outbound sales professional to join our team.



This is a sales role. It is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



The main purpose of your role is simple: start conversations with prospective businesses, understand their needs and book qualified meetings.



You will spend a significant part of your working time speaking to people on the phone.



What you'll be doing



- Making outbound cold and warm calls to prospective businesses

- Speaking confidently with receptionists, gatekeepers and decision-makers

- Asking good questions and actually listening to the answers

- Identifying potential needs and sales opportunities

- Handling initial objections without immediately giving up

- Communicating the value of our services clearly

- Booking qualified meetings

- Following up prospects by phone and

- Keeping accurate notes and updating our CRM

- Following up existing leads until there is a clear outcome



What we're looking for



You must have previous outbound sales, telesales, appointment-setting or business development experience.



We are looking for someone who:



- Is confident making outbound calls every day

- Can hold a natural conversation rather than simply read a script

- Understands basic sales techniques and objection handling

- Knows when to speak and, importantly, when to listen

- Can ask follow-up questions based on what a prospect actually says

- Is comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers

- Can work independently and take ownership of follow-ups

- Has professional-level spoken and written English

- Can communicate clearly, naturally and confidently in English

- Is comfortable being coached and receiving direct feedback



Please don't apply if...



Your experience is mainly general VA work, administration, data entry or
 outreach without significant telephone sales experience.



This role requires someone who is already comfortable selling and speaking to prospects on the phone. We will provide training on our business, services and approach, but we are not looking to teach someone how to sell from scratch.



When applying



Please include:



1. A short summary of your previous outbound sales experience.

2. What you were selling and who you were calling.

3. Approximately how many outbound calls you were making per day.

4. Your experience booking appointments or meetings.

5. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you'd be good at this role.

6. Link to your updated resume or cv



Applications without relevant outbound calling experience will not be progressed.

title: Dental Insurance & Billing Specialist
description:
Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics | Remote



Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM Pacific Time

Reports to: ROC Team Leader



About Us

Sola Kids Dental & Orthodontics is a growing dental group in Los Angeles, California, with four offices offering general dentistry and orthodontics to kids, teens, and adults. Our Remote Operations Coordinators (ROCs) work behind the scenes as the Office Manager’s best partner, with one goal: maximize production and collections so our teams can focus on patients.



About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-driven insurance and billing specialist to join our ROC team. You’ll make sure every patient has verified coverage before they walk in, every visit is billed right the first time, every payment lands in the right place, and every ortho account stays accurate from banding to retention. You’ll work across PPO and Denti-Cal (Medi-Cal Dental), for both general dentistry and orthodontics.



What You’ll Own



Eligibility and benefit breakdowns



Verify Denti-Cal and PPO eligibility for scheduled patients ahead of their visits, and flag anyone without active coverage

Build accurate PPO benefit breakdowns in Open Dental (maximums, deductibles, frequencies, waiting periods, coverage percentages, and ortho benefits such as lifetime maximums, age limits, and payment frequency)

Prepare routing slips 2 days ahead so insurance details match the schedule, and check the schedule throughout the day for newly added appointments

Keep patient insurance information clean and current (subscriber details, plan updates, coordination of benefits)

Alert the office and call center to inactive, terminated, or changed coverage so patients can be contacted before their visit



Payment posting and account accuracy



Post PPO and Denti-Cal insurance payments (EOBs/ERAs) quickly and accurately, and keep patient ledgers clean and balanced

Post 
 payments and keep payment records clean

Upload and attach eligibility and supporting documentation to the correct patient charts and claims



Orthodontic billing



Submit and track orthodontic insurance claims for PPO patients (initial banding, monthly/periodic billing, retention)

Monitor ortho payment plans and patient balances, and flag missed payments or discrepancies

Learn our Denti-Cal ortho process over time (we’ll train you)



Claims follow-up and audits



Work denials, rejections, and aging AR; follow up with carriers and submit appeals when needed

Audit claims and balances proactively so errors are caught early, not “fixed later”

Double-check Denti-Cal and PPO policies to prevent denials and appeals

Keep clear notes in Open Dental, close every loop with the offices, and escalate chart, billing, or documentation issues quickly and clearly



What Good Looks Like (our READY standard)



Routing Slips Prepared: Every patient’s eligibility is verified before they arrive, and routing slips match the schedule so the office can execute immediately.

Ensure Schedule & Record Accuracy: Extreme attention to detail. Insurance and billing information is entered correctly and readable for the office.

Audit & Bill Daily: Breakdowns are accurate, claims are correct, balances make sense, and errors are caught early.

Dedicated to the Office: Strong ownership mindset. You keep a running task list, close loops with confirmation, and take work off the manager’s plate.

Yield Maximum Production: Fewer eligibility surprises, fewer denials, fewer billing mistakes, and no production left on the table.



Requirements



2+ years of US dental insurance experience, including eligibility verification, benefit breakdowns, and payment posting (PPO required)

US orthodontic billing experience and a strong understanding of how ortho insurance pays over the course of treatment

Experience working denials, appeals, and AR follow-up with US carriers

Comfortable with payer portals and phone verifications

Excellent written and spoken English

Able to work ahead of the schedule and manage high daily volume without sacrificing accuracy

Proactive and dependable in a remote setting: you close loops and confirm your work

Reliable computer, fast stable internet, and a quiet workspace with backup power and internet

Available to work US Pacific Time hours



Nice to Have



Denti-Cal/Medi-Cal experience (strong plus)

Open Dental experience

Experience with patient financing or payment plan platforms such as 

A dental nerd at heart who wants to understand not just the “what” but the “why” behind our policies



Why Join Us



Long-term, stable full-time role

Paid training with a supportive, experienced team



How to Apply

Send the following:



Your resume

A short summary of your dental insurance and ortho billing experience (practices, software used, typical daily volume)

title: Remote Phone Sales Rep – Warm Leads, Short 10–15 Min Calls, $10 per Sale
description:
About us

We help people trade the financial markets with AI-powered tools and funded trading capital, without risking their own savings. We are expanding into the US market and are building our phone sales team.



Why this role is different

You don’t chase anyone. Every US lead you call has:



applied through our form

watched our 20-minute info webinar

been fully briefed by our support team



They already know what we offer and what it costs. They’re warm and expecting our call. Your job is to answer their last questions and help them get started.



The role

You make short, focused calls of 10–15 minutes to US leads: confirm their goals, clear up any hesitation and close them on our entry program ($179) right on the call. No cold calling, no prospecting.



What you’ll do



Call warm US leads from your call lists in our CRM (Close, with a built-in power dialer)

Build rapport quickly and confirm the lead’s interest and goals

Answer remaining questions clearly and honestly

Handle common objections such as timing, trust or “I need to think about it”

Close on the call, send the checkout link and follow up until payment is complete

Follow up with leads you couldn’t reach

Log every call: short notes, status and next step



What we’re looking for



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent

1+ year of phone sales or BPO sales experience; experience calling US customers is a big plus

Confident, friendly and to the point: you can close on the first call without being pushy

Organized, reliable and clean with CRM notes

Night shift: your shift falls within 10 am – 10 pm US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday

Quiet home workspace, stable internet with a backup (e.g. mobile data) and a noise-cancelling headset

You never make income or profit promises, and you follow US calling rules (calls only between 9 am and 9 pm in the lead’s local time)



Compensation (paid monthly in USD)



$750 base in month 1, then $1,000/month once you reach 60 sales in a month

+ $15 commission per sale, no cap

Full-time reps closing 3–5 sales per day earn $1,900–$2,500/month from month 2

Commission is paid on completed, non-refunded sales

Independent contractor, fully home-based



What you get



Warm, pre-educated US leads only: no cold calling

Short calls with a simple offer, so you close on the first call

A proven process that already works in our European market

A growth path into a high-ticket closer role



To apply

Send a 60–90 second voice note or video introducing yourself in English, and answer these 3 questions:



What have you sold by phone before, and what was your close rate?

A lead says “It sounds good, but I need to think about it.” What do you say?

Can you work US hours (night shift in PH time), Monday to Friday?

 whether a product is actually selling right now? Which data do you look at, and where do you find it?

title: Photo Editor (Social Media Content)
description:
WE'RE HIRING: PHOTO EDITOR (SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT)



Focus: Photo Editing, Retouching, and Color Grading

Platforms: Instagram (Stories & Feed Posts) and

Work Setup: Remote | Part-Time | Flexible Schedule

Compensation: $60 USD per week (Fixed Retainer)



ABOUT THE COMPANY



We are a small production company currently preparing for our content launch, with publishing expected to begin in early December 2026.



As we build our production workflow and creative team, we're looking for a dedicated Photo Editor who can contribute to the visual quality and consistency of our content. This is an opportunity to become part of a growing team and establish a long-term working relationship as our production develops.



JOB DESCRIPTION



We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Photo Editor with a strong eye for composition, color, and visual aesthetics. The ideal candidate knows how to transform photos into polished, professional, and visually appealing content while maintaining a natural and authentic look.



We're looking for someone who understands that great photo editing isn't always about dramatic changes. It's about knowing how to make subtle yet impactful adjustments that elevate an image without making it look overly edited.



This role is strictly focused on photo editing, NOT graphic design. The primary responsibility is to enhance existing photographs for social media use, particularly Instagram Stories, Instagram feed posts, and
 content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit, enhance, and retouch photographs to achieve a clean, polished, and professional aesthetic.

- Apply thoughtful color grading and color correction to create visually cohesive imagery.

- Demonstrate a strong understanding of composition, framing, lighting, contrast, and visual balance.

- Make subtle but effective adjustments that elevate an image while preserving its natural appearance.

- Crop and optimize images for Instagram Stories, Instagram feed posts, and
.

- Maintain consistent editing quality and visual style across multiple images and content batches.

- Collaborate closely with the creative team and supervisors to ensure edits align with the intended visual direction.

- Incorporate feedback and execute revisions accurately and efficiently.

- Organize and deliver final edited images according to project requirements and deadlines.



QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS



- Proven experience in professional photo editing, retouching, and color grading.

- Proficiency in Adobe Lightroom and Adobe Photoshop, or equivalent professional photo editing software.

- Excellent understanding of color theory, tones, exposure, highlights, shadows, and skin tones.

- A strong sense of visual composition and attention to small details.

- Ability to achieve natural-looking, refined, and high-end edits without excessive filters or overprocessing.

- Familiarity with image dimensions, aspect ratios, and export requirements for Instagram and
.

- Ability to adapt editing styles based on creative direction, references, and brand aesthetics.

- Strong time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines.



TEAMWORK & PROFESSIONAL ATTITUDE



We value someone who is not only technically skilled but also professional, collaborative, and receptive to feedback.



The ideal candidate should:



- Be open to constructive criticism and understand that revisions are a natural part of the creative process.

- Take direction well from supervisors, creative leads, and other team members.

- Accept feedback professionally without becoming defensive or overly attached to their initial edits.

- Communicate clearly, ask relevant questions, and provide updates when needed.

- Be flexible and willing to refine edits until they meet the team's creative standards.

- Demonstrate reliability, accountability, and a positive attitude toward collaboration.



PORTFOLIO REQUIREMENTS



Applicants must submit a portfolio showcasing:



- Before-and-after photo editing samples.

- Examples of professional color grading and color correction.

- Images demonstrating strong composition, lighting adjustments, and natural retouching.

- Social media-ready photography, preferably for Instagram and
.



We are particularly interested in editors who can make a photograph look noticeably better without making the editing itself the center of attention.



HOW TO APPLY



All interested applicants must send their applications DIRECTLY to our recruitment
:



----------





 Subject: Photo Editor Application - [Your Full Name]



Please include the following in your
:



1. Full Name & Brief Introduction - Tell us a little about yourself and your background in photo editing.



2. Portfolio Link - Share your best work, preferably including before-and-after editing samples that demonstrate your retouching, color grading, and photo enhancement skills.



3. Relevant Experience - Briefly describe your professional photo editing experience and the types of projects you've worked on.



4. Editing Software - Specify the software you primarily use (Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, or equivalent).



5. Availability & Rate Confirmation - Confirm your availability for a remote, part-time arrangement and that you are comfortable with the fixed $60 USD weekly retainer.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



All applications must be submitted directly to the
 address provided above so our team can properly review, screen, and vet each applicant.



Please do not submit applications, portfolio links, or expressions of interest through OnlineJobs.ph messages, social media comments, or direct messages.



Only applications received through our designated recruitment
 will be considered for evaluation.



Our team will review each submission based on portfolio quality, technical skills, editing style, relevant experience, and overall suitability for the role.



Shortlisted applicants will be contacted directly via
 regarding the next steps in the selection process.



IMPORTANT NOTE: THIS IS NOT A GRAPHIC DESIGNER POSITION



We are not looking for someone to create layouts, typography, promotional materials, or graphic elements.



We are looking for a dedicated Photo Editor whose strength lies in enhancing the quality, mood, composition, and overall visual impact of photographs.



Our ideal editing style is subtle, intentional, polished, and professional, where every adjustment serves a purpose and the final image speaks for itself.



COMPENSATION & WORK ARRANGEMENT



- Rate: $60 USD per week (Fixed Retainer)

- Work Setup: Remote

- Employment Arrangement: Part-Time, Retainer-Based

- Schedule: Flexible

- Workload: Light and project-based, depending on content production needs



This is a retainer-based position with a relatively light and flexible workload. The Photo Editor will work as part of an existing production team, alongside a Producer/Manager, Video Editor, and Social Media Manager.



Since the majority of production and content management responsibilities are handled by other team members, this role is focused exclusively on photo editing, retouching, and color grading.



Editing requests will depend on the availability of new content. There may be days or even weeks when little to no editing work is required.



The $60 USD weekly retainer will remain consistent during these quieter periods, as the role is intended to maintain an ongoing working relationship with a reliable Photo Editor.



We are looking for someone who can accommodate occasional editing requests, communicate effectively with the team, and deliver polished results within agreed deadlines.



Any significant increase in workload or responsibilities will be discussed separately.



JOIN OUR CREATIVE TEAM



We're looking for someone who values quality over excessive editing, understands the importance of visual consistency, and takes pride in delivering professional results.



If you have a strong eye for photography, a refined editing style, and a collaborative mindset, we'd be interested in reviewing your work.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

WHAT WE CARE ABOUT MOST

This is one of the most important parts of this position.



We need someone who is extremely careful with their work.



Someone who notices small mistakes.



Someone who checks everything twice.



Someone who cares about whether the product image is accurate.



Someone who notices if a color is wrong.



Someone who notices if a size or variant is missing.



Someone who notices spelling, formatting, pricing, images, and product information errors.



We want someone who is almost obsessive about accuracy and quality.



Speed is important, but accuracy comes first.



We would rather have someone who is fast AND extremely careful than someone who is fast but constantly makes mistakes.





AI EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already have experience using AI tools as part of your product page workflow.



You should be comfortable using tools such as:



• ChatGPT

• Gemini

• AI image generation/editing tools



You need to know how to give AI detailed instructions and how to recognize when an AI-generated image is incorrect.



You should already understand how to create professional product images while keeping the original product accurate.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have:



• 3+ years of experience creating Shopify product pages

• Real hands-on Shopify experience

• Experience with Shopify product variants

• Experience with 1688

• Your own 1688 account

• Experience using AI for product images

• Experience creating high-volume product pages

• Ability to create approximately 10 complete pages per day

• Excellent attention to detail

• Excellent organization

• Strong written English

• Ability to work independently





DO NOT APPLY IF



• You have less than 3 years of product page experience

• You have never created Shopify product pages

• You do not have 1688 experience

• You do not have a 1688 account

• You have no experience using AI for product images

• You cannot create approximately 10 pages per day

• You regularly make careless mistakes

• You need constant supervision

• You are not extremely detail-oriented

• You are looking for a beginner position

• You are not interested in staying with a company long term





WE WANT SOMEONE WHO



Takes ownership of their work.



Is extremely organized.



Is very careful.



Pays attention to small details.



Learns quickly.



Learns from mistakes and does not keep making the same mistake.



Takes pride in their work.



Has passion for creating high-quality product pages.



Wants to improve their skills.



Wants to grow with the company long term.



Has a strong work ethic and does not need to be constantly reminded what to do.





APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer EVERY question.



Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

2. Approximately how many Shopify product pages have you personally created?

title: Senior Accounts Receivable & Credit Control Lead – Australian Trade Services
description:
SENIOR ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE & CREDIT CONTROL LEAD

Australian Trade Services | Full-Time | Remote – Philippines

PHP 100,000–130,000 gross base per month, depending on demonstrated experience



OWN COLLECTIONS ACROSS THREE AUSTRALIAN BUSINESSES



Plumbing Bros West Coast, Electrical Bros West Coast and Plumbing Bros Melbourne are seeking an experienced, hands-on collections professional to take responsibility for our receivables function.



Our businesses provide plumbing and electrical services to homeowners, property managers and commercial customers. You will manage a portfolio of approximately AUD 750,000 across the three businesses.



This is a senior, hands-on role. You will personally make collection calls, investigate invoice queries, resolve account discrepancies and drive follow-through with our Australian operations and finance teams. You will own the function as an individual contributor, rather than manage a team of collectors.



WHAT OWNERSHIP LOOKS LIKE HERE



You organise your day around the accounts that matter most. When payment is blocked, you investigate the reason, obtain missing information, agree the next step and follow it through.



You communicate with management using facts, recommendations and clear decisions required. You act confidently within agreed approval limits and escalate promptly when needed. You keep accurate records and ensure active matters have a next action and due date.



We expect initiative and accountability from your first day. We provide training in our systems and business processes so you can progressively take over the portfolio with confidence.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Build and execute a daily collections plan across all three businesses, considering outstanding value, age, payment history, broken promises, disputes and customer relationships.

• Contact Australian customers confidently by telephone, supported by professional
 and SMS follow-up.

• Obtain specific payment commitments, monitor agreed dates and follow through until payment is received or an appropriate resolution is agreed.

• Investigate work orders, quotes, variations, approvals, job notes, photos and customer communications in Ascora.

• Establish the correct customer, business entity and amount before pursuing a disputed invoice.

• Work with operations and tradespeople to obtain missing information and resolve invoice queries. Bring a recommended action when management approval is required.

• Allocate payments and reconcile customer accounts in Ascora and Xero within agreed access and approval controls. Investigate unmatched payments and discrepancies promptly.

• Maintain clear records of collection activity, disputes, payment promises, next actions, owners and due dates.

• Report verified collections, overdue movements, expected receipts, risks and blockers by business.

• Identify recurring causes of slow payment and help improve our collections processes.

• Handle customers respectfully and follow company collection procedures, privacy requirements and approval limits.



EXPERIENCE YOU WILL BRING



• Typically 5+ years of hands-on accounts receivable and collections experience, including at least 3 years collecting from Australian customers.

• Direct collections experience in Australian trade services, maintenance or construction. Plumbing, electrical, HVAC or similar field-service experience is particularly valuable.

• Experience investigating invoices against work orders, quotations, variations, approvals and job records.

• Evidence of personally improving collection outcomes. You can explain the starting position, the actions you took, the timeframe and the results.

• Confident conversational English for payment discussions and concise, professional written communication.

• Strong Xero skills, practical Excel or Google Sheets ability and experience handling customer balances across multiple entities.

• Experience with Ascora, Simpro, ServiceM8 or a comparable job-management platform. Ascora-specific training will be provided.

• Sound judgement, accurate record-keeping and dependable follow-through without repeated reminders.

• A reliable computer, quiet home office, dependable internet and a practical plan for power or connectivity interruptions.



OUR WORKING CULTURE



We are a fast-paced business where priorities can change during the day. You need to stay organised, communicate early, ask focused questions and finish what you start.



You will work closely with our Australian operations and finance teams, with a nominated manager for guidance and escalation. We value people who apply feedback quickly, raise problems honestly and contribute practical improvements.



Our 5-Star Values are Customer Commitment, Ownership, Relentless Drive, Continuous Improvement and Leadership.



SYSTEMS



Ascora, Xero, Microsoft Outlook / Microsoft 365, Excel / Google Sheets, Avaya and Go High Level. Software access and system training will be provided.



WORKING ARRANGEMENTS AND REMUNERATION



• Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

• Remote position based in the Philippines.

• Standard hours: 8:00 am–5:00 pm Philippine/Perth time, including a one-hour lunch break.

• Responsibility across Perth and Melbourne, with Melbourne customer follow-up prioritised earlier in the day.

• PHP 100,000–130,000 gross base per month, depending on demonstrated relevant experience and assessment performance.

• Performance bonus opportunity, with terms discussed during the recruitment process.

• Long-term opportunity with structured onboarding, system training and support from our Australian team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Your updated CV, including the Australian businesses or sectors you have supported, dates, systems used and the collections responsibilities you personally owned.

2. A short example of a difficult overdue account or portfolio you improved: the starting balance or problem, your actions, the measurable result and the timeframe. Identify any figures that are approximate and do not disclose confidential customer information.

3. Details of your Australian trades, maintenance or construction experience and the types of invoice disputes you have handled.

4. Your expected monthly gross salary in PHP, notice period and availability for the stated working hours.



Application subject line: SENIOR AR LEAD – Your Full Name



OUR SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates will attend a structured interview and complete an unpaid, live practical assessment using fictional customer information. You will prioritise accounts, investigate an invoice dispute, conduct a collection-call role-play and complete a short learning exercise.



Part of the assessment will be completed without generative AI; another part will allow approved tools. We will explain the format and tool rules beforehand. We assess your judgement, accuracy, communication and ability to apply feedback—not simply how polished an answer sounds.



Relevant professional references will be requested from finalists with their consent.



We are looking for a long-term team member who takes pride in achieving results, maintaining customer relationships and following matters through to completion.

title: PART-TIME CREATIVE VIDEO EDITOR
description:
We want videos people actually want to watch.



Inner Fire is an Australian pure cacao brand, and we're looking for a creative video editor who can turn ordinary footage into engaging, distinctive and memorable content.



We're not just looking for someone who knows how to cut clips and add transitions. We want someone who understands storytelling, knows how to capture attention, and can bring a message to life through creative editing.



Think clever storytelling, viral-worthy content, a little humour, unexpected creative touches and a polished, premium feel. Videos that make people stop scrolling, spark curiosity and leave them wanting to know more.



***WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING***



- Edit short-form videos for social media, paid advertisements and marketing materials.

- Turn provided raw footage into engaging and visually compelling content.

- Develop creative approaches, hooks and storytelling techniques that capture attention.

- Incorporate music, sound effects, captions, typography, motion graphics and transitions.

- Follow Inner Fire's brand guidelines, ensuring consistency in colours, typography, visual identity and overall aesthetic.

- Bring fresh ideas while keeping the intended message and marketing objectives in mind.

- Work with feedback and deliver projects within agreed timelines.



***THE CREATIVE DIRECTION WE'RE AFTER***



We're looking for someone who can balance:



- Engagement: Understands what makes people stop scrolling, watch and share.

- Storytelling: Can communicate the essence of a message through thoughtful editing.

- Personality: Knows how to incorporate clever humour and unexpected moments without forcing it.

- Premium execution: Has a strong creative eye for visuals, pacing, composition and sound design.

- Originality: Goes beyond generic templates, repetitive transitions and copy-and-paste social media edits.

- Brand consistency: Can bring creative ideas to life while respecting and following established brand guidelines.



***WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR***



- Proven video editing experience, preferably in short-form social media content and digital advertising.

- A strong portfolio showcasing creativity, storytelling and editing versatility.

- Good understanding of social media trends, audience engagement and video retention.

- Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or similar editing tools.

- Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and communicate effectively.

- Resourcefulness, attention to detail and openness to feedback.

- Experience working with creators, influencers, lifestyle, food or established consumer brands is a plus, but not a requirement. We're more interested in the quality of your work and your creative ability than the names on your portfolio.



***WORKING ARRANGEMENT & EXPECTATIONS***



- Part-time / Freelance, remote arrangement.

- Project-based assignments with potential for ongoing collaboration.

- Flexible working schedule, with agreed deadlines and deliverables.

- Rates based on experience, project scope and proposed arrangement.



We value honesty, transparency and accountability just as much as creativity. We expect reasonable and transparent pricing, realistic time estimates and honest reporting of actual hours worked. Any additional time or work outside the agreed scope should be communicated and approved beforehand.



We're not looking for rushed work, but we do appreciate efficiency, resourcefulness and people who take ownership of their responsibilities.



***PRACTICAL EDITING ASSESSMENT***



Shortlisted applicants will be given a practical editing exercise using footage and brand materials provided by Inner Fire.



Practice Test Materials (Google Drive):





Your task: Create a 15–30-second short-form video that captures attention, communicates the intended message and reflects Inner Fire's creative direction and brand guidelines.



We encourage your own creative interpretation. There is no prescribed editing formula or template.



Please submit:



- Your completed video.

- A brief explanation of your creative concept.

- Estimated editing time and actual time spent.



The assessment is for recruitment purposes only. Submissions will not be used commercially without a separate agreement.



***HOW TO APPLY***



Please send the following, including the Practice Test Video, to this
: 



- A portfolio or showreel of your previous work.

- A brief introduction and relevant experience.

- Your preferred editing software.

- Your rates for 15–30-second and 30–60-second videos, including hourly or monthly package rates, if applicable.

- Estimated turnaround times and revision policy.

- Your availability for a part-time arrangement.



We're looking for someone who doesn't just edit videos but knows how to make a story worth watching.



Creative, resourceful, detail-oriented and someone who brings something different to the table.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to see your work!

title: Executive Virtual Assistant & Travel Operations Specialist
description:
We produce an international golf television show and host boutique luxury golf tournaments and curated travel tours.

Our business runs on a clear division of focus: the founder directs filming on location, brand storytelling, television production, and hosts tournaments on camera. We are looking for a reliable, fast, detail-oriented, and systemized Executive Virtual Assistant to step into the operational side of our travel desk to coordinate supplier research, package itineraries, manage routine outbound
 outreach, provide customer service, and document standard operating procedures.

Ideal Role Fit:

This role suits a high-performing Executive Virtual Assistant, Travel Planner, or Travel Operations Specialist with strong systems discipline (high Fact Finder and Follow Through). We need someone who works fast, keeps records 100% accurate, follows checklists without supervision, and loves building clean, repeatable SOPs.

What You Will Help Execute (Phase 1 Sprint):

1.	Supplier Outreach & Wholesale Research: Contact our existing hotel and championship golf course partners in tournament destinations (and research additional options via Expedia TAAP) to confirm wholesale rates, group allocations, and terms.

2.	Ground Transport Coordination: Contact local transport providers in each region to secure private transfer rates, vehicle sizes, and luggage capacities.

3.	Google Drive Organization: Organize all confirmed wholesale pricing, rate sheets, and supplier contacts into clean, location-specific Google Drive folders.

4.	Tour Brochures & Content Formatting: Help assemble and update guest-facing brochures for tournaments and 7-night/5-round tours (with optional post-tour extensions), using tools like Gemini or Claude to refine copy in conjunction with our graphic designer.

5.	Travefy Itinerary Builds: Turn approved packages into interactive, client-ready itineraries inside Travefy.

6.	Marketing & Ads Setup: Help set up targeting and creatives for Meta ad campaigns and coordinate
 broadcasts in MailerLite using our existing media library.

7.	B2B Outbound
 Outreach: Execute routine outbound
 outreach to our existing databases of golf professionals, club general managers, and golf-playing entrepreneurs using our pre-written message templates, tracking replies and follow-ups systematically.

8.	Guest Enquiries & Customer Service: Assist with responding to incoming guest enquiries, delivering attentive customer service, collecting deposits, and logging guest details on master spreadsheets.

9.	SOP & Video Documentation: Document each of these steps into clear, written SOP guides and short Loom video walkthroughs so future team members can easily follow the process.

Who You Are:

•	Systems-Oriented & Fast: You take pride in clean spreadsheets, organized files, rapid turnaround times, and zero dropped balls.

•	Travel Operations Background: Practical experience or high comfort as a virtual assistant handling travel coordination, reservations, Travefy (or similar travel itinerary builders), and Expedia TAAP.

•	Tech-Proficient: Practical experience or high comfort with Canva, MailerLite CRM (or similar CRM platforms), and Meta Ads Manager.

•	AI-Literate: Comfortable using AI tools like Gemini or Claude to speed up copy drafting, research, and daily administrative tasks.

•	Communication Skills: Fluent in written and spoken English, friendly, steady, and thoughtful in customer interactions.

•	Process Builder: Enjoys documenting workflows and creating step-by-step Loom tutorials.

How to Apply & Screening Tasks

CRITICAL APPLICATION INSTRUCTION:

Do not use AI to generate your proposal or answers to these questions. We require an authentic, personal response written in your own voice. We want to see your genuine personality, real communication style, and what makes you stand out. Submissions containing generic, AI-generated text will be archived immediately.

Please include your answers to the three items below directly in your proposal. Submissions missing any of these requirements will be archived automatically:

1.	Travel & Virtual Assistant Experience:

Briefly detail your practical experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Travel Planner handling travel reservations, supplier outreach, and customer service. Please share 1–2 concrete examples or links to travel itineraries, spreadsheets, or booking workflows you have personally created (e.g., Travefy links, sample itinerary PDFs, or a summary of travel files you have coordinated).

2.	Attention-to-Detail Research Check:

Who are the two sisters who founded Nectar Cold Pressed in Australia?

(Important: Please do not use AI for your answer, as it will not give you the right answer. If this answer is incorrect or missing, your proposal will not be considered and will be archived automatically).

3.	90-Second Video Introduction (Mandatory):

Please record and paste a link to a maximum 90-second video introduction (hosted on Loom, Google Drive, YouTube Unlisted, or Dropbox) addressing these three points:

o	What lights you up: Tell us about your highest personal values and what you are most passionate about in life outside of work.

o	Your human superpower: What is the single distinctive character strength that truly sets you apart?

o	The one thing: What is the 1 thing that excites you most about supporting this travel and media brand?

title: Executive Support Specialist — California Insurance Experience Required
description:
Executive Support Specialist — California Insurance Experience Required

US-Based | 100% Remote | Full-Time | 2 Positions Available



The work moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About 



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



This role is focused on California insurance — personal and commercial lines. A big part of your day will be handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing. If you've worked inside a California insurance agency recently and know how personal and commercial lines operate — you'll feel right at home here. If you haven't, this role isn't the right fit.



Beyond the insurance work, you'll be supporting day-to-day operations — managing communication, keeping things organized, and making sure nothing gets missed. You'll be expected to use AI tools regularly to work faster and produce better outputs. Not occasionally. Daily.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best Executive Support Specialists we've worked with share a few traits:



They figure things out. When something comes up they haven't seen before, they don't freeze — they think it through, find a path forward, and get it done.

They don't wait to be told. If something needs to happen, they handle it — then let you know it's done, not ask for permission first.

They're honest when things go wrong. Mistakes happen. What matters is that they surface it immediately, own it, and fix it — not hope no one notices.

They're naturally curious. They ask questions other people don't think to ask. They pick up new tools and processes quickly because they actually want to understand how things work.

They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What stays in the business stays in the business — no exceptions.

They use AI like a professional tool. Not a novelty. Something they rely on daily to do better work faster.



Who Thrives Here



People who are quietly excellent. You don't need recognition for every task — you find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even when no one notices the work behind it.



We're a growing business, which means priorities shift and not everything is perfectly documented yet. If you're the type who takes initiative and figures things out without waiting for a perfect playbook — you'll do well here.



What You'll Do



You'll be managing a mix of insurance operations and administrative support in a fast-moving remote environment. Your job is to keep things running, stay ahead of deadlines, and make sure nothing gets dropped.



That looks like:



Handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing for personal and commercial insurance lines — this is the core of the role

Managing inbound communication across
 and phone — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs attention

Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and flagging anything at risk before it becomes a problem

Managing calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination

Preparing reports, summaries, and briefing materials that are clear and ready to use without further editing

Maintaining organized records across CRM systems and shared drives — so information is always findable and current

Using AI tools to draft communications, summarize threads, and eliminate repetitive manual tasks

Supporting market research, competitor analysis, and social media scheduling when needed



What We're Looking For



At least 1 year of recent, hands-on experience working inside a California insurance agency — personal and commercial lines — handling renewals, quoting, and account servicing; this is the non-negotiable requirement for this role

Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, easy to listen to; clients always feel heard

Proven experience in a support, virtual assistant, or administrative role

Active, confident daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent)

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace

Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent)

Strong written English —
s are clear and professional before they're sent

High attention to detail — errors get caught before they leave your desk

Strong organizational skills — multiple priorities, nothing slips

Self-directed once you're up to speed — asks the right questions early, works independently after



Nice to have:



Experience with insurance agency management systems (Applied Epic, AMS360, Hawksoft, or equivalent)

Experience with automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent)

Familiarity with ClickUp, Asana, or similar project management tools

Basic bookkeeping experience (QuickBooks or Xero)



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new team members.



In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand how things operate, our tools, our standards, and how information flows across the business. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape how they support clients and manage their work.



We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At three months:

Renewals and account servicing are running without dropped deadlines or missed follow-ups. Communication is handled, and you're already using AI tools to produce outputs faster than expected.



At six months:

You're anticipating needs before they're voiced. Repetitive tasks have been automated or streamlined. The work is running more smoothly because of systems and habits you built — without being asked.



At twelve months:

You're an indispensable part of how the business operates. Trust is solid. The work you've done — the systems, the habits, the consistency — would be immediately felt if it disappeared. 
 is investing in what's next for you.



How We Work



You won't be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients depend on us — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.



We're a growing MSP, so not every system is perfect yet and not every process is documented. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the workflows, systems, and habits that make us better as we grow.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You don't have recent experience working inside a California insurance agency — personal and commercial lines

You need constant check-ins and direction to stay on track

You let things slip and wait for someone else to catch it

You'd stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation

Confidentiality feels optional depending on the situation

You've never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don't plan to start

Shifting priorities and imperfect systems frustrate rather than motivate you



There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: Senior IT Engineer

Prevent problems before they happen. Automate what shouldn’t be done twice. Do great work with great clients — and earn the autonomy to do it your way.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to close tickets faster. You’re here to make sure the same problem doesn’t come back — and ideally, to catch it before it ever reaches a ticket queue.



We’re looking for a Senior IT Engineer who thinks like an automator and operator first, a firefighter second. You’ll handle complex Tier 2/3 escalations when they arise, but your real work is building the systems, automations, and processes that prevent issues from happening in the first place. You’ll own client environments, lead from the front technically, and raise the standard of the team around you.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best engineers we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They hate doing the same thing twice. If they fix something manually, their next thought is: “How do I make sure no one — including me — has to do this again?”

They take ownership. From the 
nt a problem is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s fully resolved, documented, and won’t come back

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I fix this faster?” they ask “why is this happening, and how do I prevent it?”

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and resolutions are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to



Who Thrives Here



People who want to do genuinely good work, be trusted by their team, and build something that lasts. We move fast and hold a high bar — but we’ve also built an environment where people are respected, given real ownership, and invested in over time. Those things aren’t in conflict here.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is fully documented and not every system is perfect yet. For the right engineer, that’s not a problem — it’s the opportunity to shape how we operate, not just execute within it.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a fast-moving MSP environment where clients depend on you and junior engineers look to you. Your job isn’t just to solve the problem in front of you — it’s to make sure the team and the environment are better because you were there.



That looks like:



Serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and endpoint security — diagnosing root causes, not patching symptoms

Proactively auditing client environments to catch risks, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies before they become i

Building monitoring, alerting, and automation that catches problems early — or eliminates them entirely

Leading infrastructure projects end-to-end — cloud migrations, M365 deployments, network overhauls, security implementations — from scoping through delivery

Writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts that turn repetitive manual tasks into automated, reliable processes

description:

If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary.



We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?”

They take ownership. From the moment a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them.

They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?”

They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for.

They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to.



Who Thrives Here



People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better.



You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane.



We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point.

Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them

Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question

Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better



What We’re Looking For



Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on

Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; you treat Excel as a serious tool, not a last resort

Solid experience with SQL and database querying — you can get to the data you need without waiting for someone else to pull it

Experience with Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools — you know when to code and when not to

Natural systems thinker — you look at a process and immediately see how it should be redesigned, not just optimized

Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments

Reporting workflows that used to take hours run themselves

The business operates measurably faster and more accurately than before you joined

title: Accountant - U.S. GAAP Experience
description:
Remote Accountant | U.S. GAAP Experience Required



Location: Remote | International Applicants Welcome

Engagement: Independent Contractor | Long-Term Opportunity

About the Opportunity



We are seeking an experienced Remote Accountant to support the accounting and financial operations of multiple U.S.-based companies across several industries.



This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on accounting professional who is comfortable managing multiple responsibilities, working independently and supporting a growing organization with diverse accounting needs.



Direct experience performing accounting work under U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (U.S. GAAP) for U.S.-based companies is a mandatory requirement.



We are looking for someone with practical accounting experience who can contribute beyond routine bookkeeping and take ownership of accounting responsibilities with accuracy, sound judgment and consistent follow-through.



Key Responsibilities



Prepare and post journal entries, accruals and adjusting entries.



Perform bank, credit card, general ledger and balance-sheet reconciliations.



Support monthly, quarterly and year-end closing activities.



Prepare financial statements, supporting schedules and management reports.



Maintain accurate general ledger records across multiple business entities.



Investigate discrepancies, research accounting issues and resolve errors.



Support accounts payable, accounts receivable and intercompany accounting.



Assist with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis and cash-flow reporting.



Coordinate audit documentation and support financial compliance requirements.



Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, reporting and efficiency.



Collaborate with U.S.-based Finance leadership and operational teams.



Required Qualifications



Applicants must meet all of the following qualifications:



Minimum 3 years of direct, hands-on accounting experience applying U.S. GAAP for U.S.-based companies.



At least 3-5 years of professional accounting experience with meaningful responsibility for general ledger accounting and financial reporting.



Demonstrated experience with journal entries, accruals, reconciliations and monthly or quarterly closing processes.



Experience preparing or substantially contributing to financial statements.



Ability to independently investigate accounting discrepancies and resolve problems.



Proficiency with accounting software or ERP systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Xero or comparable platforms.



Strong Microsoft Excel skills and attention to detail.



Strong written and spoken English communication skills.



Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and work independently with minimal supervision.



Important: General bookkeeping, AP/AR processing, external audit experience or employment with an international organization does not independently satisfy the required hands-on U.S. GAAP accounting experience.

title: Home Care Scheduler
description:
OPA Home Care is a private home care company serving the Atlanta metro area. Our standard is zero missed shifts. When a caregiver calls out, a client still needs care that day, and this job makes sure the shift is covered.



THE WORK



You staff every client shift with a qualified caregiver and keep a named backup on each one. You confirm every shift with the caregiver, including an evening confirmation for that night and the next day. When a caregiver calls out, you answer within 15 minutes and confirm a replacement within 30 to 60 minutes. Any missed shift goes to our Director of Operations the same day. You own an assigned client list and send a written end-of-day report on every open item.



Every confirmation, call-out, and schedule change goes into AxisCare, our system of record, the same day. If it is not in AxisCare, it did not happen.



WHAT WE MEASURE



- Missed shifts: zero

- Call-outs answered: within 15 minutes

- Replacement caregiver confirmed: within 30 to 60 minutes

- Schedule changes logged in AxisCare: same day, every one



WHAT YOU BRING



- Fluent spoken and written English

- Experience assigning shifts in scheduling, dispatch, or coordination

- Experience working remotely with a U.S. team

- Comfort making phone calls all day and solving coverage problems on the phone



Experience in home care scheduling, healthcare staffing, or as a medical virtual assistant is preferred, and so is experience with AxisCare, WellSky (ClearCare), or AlayaCare.



THE ARRANGEMENT



- Engagement: Independent contractor

- Fee: $750 USD a month, fixed

- Hours: U.S. daytime business hours (Eastern)

- Equipment: You provide your own computer, noise-canceling headset, stable internet, and backup power.



HOW TO APPLY



Complete the application form at the link below. It takes about 10 minutes and includes a 60-second recorded answer. Applications sent only through OnlineJobs.ph messages are not reviewed.

title: LinkedIn Content Researcher & Ghostwriter – Google Ads, AI & Automation
description:
LINKEDIN CONTENT RESEARCHER & GHOSTWRITER – GOOGLE ADS, AI & AUTOMATION



Company: Envoko

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment: Part-time, long-term

Working hours: 5–7 hours per week

Salary: $8–12 USD/hour

Start: As soon as possible



ABOUT ENVOKO



Envoko is a digital marketing agency focused on helping Danish e-commerce businesses achieve profitable growth through Google Ads, Meta Ads, and marketing automation.



We are looking for a creative, proactive, and independent LinkedIn Content Researcher & Ghostwriter to help build the personal LinkedIn presence of our founder.



Our content will primarily focus on Google Ads, AI agents, scripts, automation, and profitable e-commerce growth.



This is NOT a traditional social media assistant role.



We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions or produces generic AI-generated content.



We want someone who takes initiative, discovers interesting topics, and helps us create genuinely useful and engaging content.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



1. PROACTIVE RESEARCH & IDEA GENERATION



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



You will independently research Google Ads, AI, automation, and e-commerce developments.



Examples of what you might discover:



- Interesting Google Ads scripts on GitHub.

- New AI agents that could help e-commerce businesses.

- Google Ads updates worth discussing.

- Automation workflows that save time or improve performance.

- Useful AI tools, prompts, and practical techniques.

- Emerging technologies relevant to online advertising.



Every week, you should proactively suggest 3–5 relevant content ideas.



For each idea, explain what it is, why it matters, and how we could turn it into an interesting LinkedIn post.



We want YOU to bring ideas to us, not wait for us to provide every topic.



2. FOUNDER INTERVIEWS & COLLABORATION



You will have regular conversations with our founder in English, typically 30–60 minutes per week.



Your responsibilities include:



- Discussing your research and content ideas.

- Interviewing the founder about Google Ads and e-commerce.

- Asking insightful follow-up questions.

- Capturing his opinions, experiences, and personal perspective.

- Challenging ideas and helping develop stronger content angles.



You should feel comfortable leading these conversations.



Your job is to understand how our founder thinks and communicates so the content feels genuinely personal and authentic.



3. LINKEDIN GHOSTWRITING



You will create approximately three high-quality LinkedIn posts per week for our founder's personal profile.



Content topics include:



- Google Ads strategies and common mistakes.

- Google Shopping and Performance Max.

- AI agents and marketing automation.

- Useful Google Ads scripts and tools.

- ROAS, profitability, and e-commerce growth.

- Practical tutorials and downloadable resources.

- Interesting developments in AI and digital marketing.

- Personal experiences and opinions about running a marketing agency.



Some posts will come from founder interviews.



Others should come from your own research, with the founder adding his perspective and approving the final content.



Our target audience is Danish e-commerce business owners, founders, CEOs, and marketing managers.



The goal is to build authority, provide practical value, and attract relevant business opportunities.



We are NOT interested in generic motivational posts, exaggerated claims, or recycled AI content.



4. AI-ASSISTED DANISH CONTENT



Our LinkedIn posts will primarily be published in Danish.



You do not need to speak Danish fluently.



However, you must be highly comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools to create natural and professional Danish content from English interviews and research.



We will provide writing examples, feedback, and guidance on our founder's personal tone of voice.



You must be willing to improve continuously.



All posts must be reviewed and approved before publication.



5. CONTENT MANAGEMENT & PUBLISHING



You will take ownership of the content workflow.



This includes:



- Maintaining a simple content calendar.

- Organising ideas and research.

- Preparing drafts for approval.

- Making revisions based on feedback.

- Scheduling approved LinkedIn posts.

- Monitoring relevant comments and engagement.

- Identifying interesting potential business conversations.

- Providing a short monthly performance summary.



We want someone who can manage the process independently with minimal supervision.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required skills:



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong online research skills.

- Experience writing engaging LinkedIn content.

- Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools.

- Ability to interview people and ask insightful questions.

- Ability to turn technical subjects into clear and interesting content.

- Genuine curiosity about AI, automation, and technology.

- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Independent thinking and a proactive attitude.



Nice to have:



- Experience with Google Ads or performance marketing.

- Understanding of e-commerce.

- Familiarity with Google Ads Scripts.

- Experience with AI agents, n8n, Make, or Zapier.

- Basic knowledge of GitHub or APIs.

- Experience ghostwriting for entrepreneurs or agency founders.



You do NOT need to be a developer or advanced Google Ads specialist.



We value curiosity, creativity, research skills, and initiative.



IMPORTANT: ACCURACY AND QUALITY



We take accuracy seriously.



You must always verify information before presenting it as fact.



Scripts and AI tools must not be described as tested or developed by Envoko unless we have actually tested or developed them.



You must never invent customer cases, performance results, or personal experiences.



We want useful, trustworthy content that reflects our founder's real opinions and expertise.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After the initial onboarding period, you should be able to:



- Independently discover interesting content opportunities.

- Suggest 3–5 useful ideas each week.

- Create three high-quality LinkedIn posts per week.

- Understand and consistently reflect our founder's personal writing style.

- Research Google Ads scripts, AI agents, and automation tools.

- Manage the entire content calendar and approval process.

- Work proactively without constant instructions.



Our founder should primarily spend time sharing his knowledge, discussing interesting ideas, and approving content.



You should take ownership of everything else.



WORKING HOURS & COMPENSATION



- Initially 5–7 hours per week.

- Flexible working hours.

- $8–12 USD per hour, depending on experience.

- Four-week paid trial.

- Opportunity to increase hours over time.

- Long-term collaboration for the right person.



We value results and quality over time spent online.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions in your application.



1. LINKEDIN EXPERIENCE



Share 2–3 examples of LinkedIn posts you have written for founders, business owners, or companies.



2. RESEARCH CHALLENGE



Find ONE interesting Google Ads script, AI agent, or marketing automation tool that could be useful for e-commerce businesses.



Explain:



- What does it do?

- Why is it useful?

- How could we turn it into an interesting LinkedIn post?



Include a link to the original source.



3. CONTENT CREATION



Imagine you have a 30-minute interview with a founder about Google Ads.



How would you turn that conversation into three engaging LinkedIn posts?



4. AI & DANISH WRITING



How would you use AI tools to create natural, high-quality LinkedIn content in Danish when you don't speak Danish yourself?



5. PROACTIVITY



Tell us about a situation where you independently discovered a useful content idea or opportunity without being asked.



6. AVAILABILITY



Please include your expected hourly rate, weekly availability, and earliest possible start date.



7. SHORT INTRODUCTION



Please include a short voice recording or video introduction in English explaining why you're interested in this role.



IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Start your application with the exact words:



Google Ads Meets AI



This helps us identify applicants who have read the complete job description.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid practical assignment.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us and become a valuable long-term content partner.



We look forward to hearing from you!

Meet the Founders

 followers on
